entries.source: Selected: Strict Much like moderate, except hosts have larger egos and the simulation is a little less forgiving. If you are detected, each member of the AI squad that detected you receives a 50% ego boost and deploys a protective recharger shield which absorbs 50% damage. Recommended for stealth-bots.
entries.translation: 已选择：严苛 与适中难度大体相似， 但宿主的自我值更高， 模拟环境也更不留情面。 一旦被发现，发现你的AI小队 每位成员都会获得50%的自我值加成， 并部署可吸收50%伤害的充能护盾。 推荐潜行型机器人选择。

entries.source: Selected: Severe Enemies and damage are brutal. Resources deplete fast. Hosts have even larger egos. The simulation wants you to fail. If you are detected, each member of the AI squad that detected you receives a 100% ego boost and deploys a protective recharger shield which absorbs 80% damage. Recommended for 1990s Gamers.
entries.translation: 已选择：残酷 敌人十分凶猛，伤害极高。 资源消耗迅速，宿主的自我值更高。 模拟系统巴不得你失败。 一旦被发现，发现你的AI小队 每位成员都会获得100%的自我值加成， 并部署可吸收80%伤害的充能护盾。 推荐1990年代的老派玩家选择。

entries.source:
<color=yellow>The recommended way to experience Ctrl Alt Ego the first time through.</color>
 
Full, continuous campaign, with story.
Ego, upgrades, abilities and ctrl'd robots accumulate / carry over as you progress.
All tutorial content is included.
entries.translation:
<color=yellow>初次体验 Ctrl Alt Ego 的推荐方式。</color>
 
包含完整剧情的连贯战役。
随着进度推进，自我、升级、能力以及受 Ctrl 的机器人都会积累并继承。
包含所有教程内容。

entries.source:
Browse standalone missions. Missions enable you to replay segments from the main campaign, or provide a fresh challenge. Upgrades and abilities don't carry over between standalone missions.
 
<color=yellow>SPOILER WARNING: Playing missions at locations you've not yet reached in the main campaign may spoil the story!</color>
entries.translation:
浏览独立任务。任务可让你重玩主战役的片段，或提供全新的挑战。独立任务之间不会继承升级和能力。
 
<color=yellow>剧透警告：游玩主战役中尚未抵达的地点对应的任务可能会导致剧透！</color>

entries.source:
Your ego is rudely crammed inside physics-driven robots.
The most characterful option, but may take some getting used to.
The developer preferred setting.
entries.translation:
你的自我被粗暴地塞进由物理驱动的机器人体内。
最具特色的选项，但可能需要适应一段时间。
开发者偏好的设置。

entries.source: Reduce the most common causes of motion-sickness while retaining some of the flavour of being a disembodied ego.
entries.translation: 减少引起晕动症的最常见因素，同时保留无实体自我的一部分独特体验。

entries.source: Suppress all potential causes of motion-sickness.
entries.translation: 抑制所有可能导致晕动症的因素。

entries.source:
Retain the current settings. Adjust at any time via
Menu > Settings > Camera / Motion > Customize
entries.translation:
保留当前设置。可随时通过以下路径调整：
菜单 > 设置 > 动态 / 镜头 > 自定义

entries.source:
Eliminate wobbly robot sideways camera 'roll'.
Clumsy robots is half the charm, but if it's making you feel nauseous, check this option!
entries.translation:
消除机器人摇摇晃晃的侧向镜头“横滚”。
笨拙的机器人虽是魅力所在，但如果让你感到反胃，请勾选此项！

entries.source:
FOV: Adjusts the camera Field Of View for mobile bots.
FOV is part of the 'feel' of being different bots and the default (MIN) is the developer preferred setting.
But it's fine, do what you need to do.
entries.translation:
FOV：调整移动机器人的镜头视野（Field Of View）。
FOV是化身不同机器人时“手感”的一部分，默认值（最小）也是开发者推荐的设置。
不过没关系，随你喜好调整即可。

entries.source:
Replace Ctrl Alt Ego's signature HOP animation with a much less interesting 'blink' effect.
Check this option if and only if the HOP animation is making you feel queasy!
entries.translation:
将Ctrl Alt Ego标志性的跃迁动画替换为无趣得多的“瞬移闪烁”效果。
仅在跃迁动画确实让你感到恶心时才勾选此项！

entries.source: Stop ctrld Bugs from bobbing gently up and down.
entries.translation: 停止受控BUG轻微上下起伏的晃动。
减少机器人的“滑动”运动

entries.source:
Insights provide local area hints.
If you prefer to read the environment and interpret clues for yourself, disable this option.
entries.translation:
“洞察提示”提供当前区域的提示。
如果你更喜欢观察环境并自行解读线索，请禁用此项。

entries.source:
Point Of Interest (POI) markers act as navigational aids.
If you prefer to explore and find locations and items independently, disable this option.
entries.translation:
兴趣点（POI）标记可用作导航辅助。
如果你更喜欢自主探索并寻找地点与物品，请禁用此项。

entries.source: Note: Certain POIs essential to the story are always displayed.
entries.translation: 注意：某些对剧情至关重要的兴趣点将始终显示。

显示/隐藏不同宿主的不同操作按键。

信息会显示在HUD底部，以引起你对重要情报的注意。

强烈建议所有玩家开启

entries.translation: 你确定要删除此档案吗？该档案的所有存档都将被抹除。

entries.source:
Play a sub-section of the main campaign, with or without your choice of starting equipment.

<color=yellow>Note that choosing a mission you haven't yet encountered during the main campaign will almost certainly spoiler the story.</color>
entries.translation:
游玩主线战役中的某个分段，可自由选择是否携带初始装备。

<color=yellow>请注意，选择你在主线战役中尚未玩到的任务，几乎肯定会被剧透剧情。</color>

entries.source:
Play a challenge mission.

Each offers a twist on the Ctrl Alt Ego formula to provide a fresh experience intended for experienced ego-bearing entities.
entries.translation:
游玩挑战任务。

每个挑战都对 Ctrl Alt Ego 的核心玩法进行了独特改动，专为经验丰富的自我承载实体带来焕然一新的体验。

entries.source:
Start with zero ego, no disks and no worms. 
Choose this option if you enjoy a challenge.
entries.translation:
开局零自我，无磁盘，无蠕虫。
若你喜欢挑战，请选择此项。

entries.source:
We the developers, in our infinite wisdom, shall grant you that which we deem perfectly appropriate and balanced for the mission.
Sometimes we want you to have to think a bit, so you can expect something of a challenge.
entries.translation:
我们开发者凭着无限的智慧，将赐予你我们认为与该任务完全契合且平衡的配置。
有时我们希望你能多动动脑子，因此这多少会有些挑战性。

entries.source: You'll start with zero ego, but you'll be gifted one or more disks and one or more worms for you to configure your Bug however you like.
entries.translation: 你开局将拥有零自我，但会获赠一张或多张磁盘以及一条或多条蠕虫，供你随心所欲地配置自己的BUG。

entries.source:
An advanced algorithm will execute on your high range GPU to generate a random loadout.
Choose this option if you just want to mess around with whatever you're given.
entries.translation:
高级算法将在你的高端GPU上运行，生成一套随机配置。
若你只想拿到什么就瞎玩什么，请选择此项。

entries.source: There are no gear options available for this mission.
entries.translation: 此任务没有可选的装备选项。

entries.source: It's recommended to complete mission '%CONTINGENCY%' before attempting this mission.
entries.translation: 建议在尝试此任务之前先完成任务“%CONTINGENCY%”。

entries.source: Open TAB/HOST to examine/edit your starting loadout
entries.translation: 打开 TAB/宿主 查看/编辑初始配置

entries.source: The Great Gig in the Sky

<color=yellow>More missions are in the works!</color>: 
 
Stealth missions. Puzzle missions. Action missions. Challenge missions. Etc missions.
 
As new missions are added, they'll be notified via the Steam Community - follow for updates!
entries.translation:
<color=yellow>更多任务正在制作中！</color>: 
 
潜行任务。解谜任务。动作任务。挑战任务。诸如此类的任务。
 
随着新任务的加入，我们将在Steam社区发布通知——欢迎关注以获取最新动态！

entries.source: The prelude from the main game, though this time you'll have more of a say over what gear you get.
entries.translation: 主线游戏的前奏部分，不过这次你能更大程度地决定自己能获得什么装备。

entries.source: An identical but standalone version of the prologue from the main campaign, so if you've already played that there's nothing new to see here.
entries.translation: 主线战役序章的完全独立版本，所以如果你已经玩过序章，这里就没什么新鲜内容了。

entries.source: A rocket needs launching and you're just the disembodied conscious entity for the job.
entries.translation: 有一枚火箭亟待发射，而你正好就是胜任这份差事的无形意识实体。

entries.source:
Another rocket needs launching and you're the only disembodied conscious entity around.
This time they've beefed up security quite considerably, so you may need to get your hands dirty.
entries.translation:
又有一枚火箭亟待发射，而附近唯一的无形意识实体就只有你了。

entries.source: Offline Sensors Host sensors may be offline for various reasons. In ego mode, offline sensors appear grey. You can't ctrl an offline sensor; it must first be brought online. A blocked sensor can be brought online by exposing it.
entries.translation: 离线传感器 宿主的传感器可能因各种原因离线。 在自我模式下，离线传感器显示为灰色。 你无法Ctrl离线传感器； 必须先让它恢复在线。 被遮挡的传感器只需解除遮挡， 就能恢复在线。

entries.source: Safe -> Unsafe Avoid causing bother in Safe hosts to avoid being reclassified Unsafe. You can get away with causing a little bother without being reclassified, but it's usually best to avoid being seen causing it. Staying Safe has its advantages, but choosing to break cover and go Unsafe at an opportune moment may confer different benefits.
entries.translation: 安全 -> 不安全 使用安全宿主时，别引起警觉， 以免被重新归类为不安全。 引起少量警觉未必会被重新归类， 但最好还是别让别人看见。 保持安全自有优势， 不过，挑准时机暴露身份、 转为不安全，也可能另有好处。

entries.source: Bother Some actions don't provoke an immediate hostile response, but instead cause bother. Once an enemy's bothered level reaches 100%, if your safe host is in sight it will be reclassified unsafe and attacked. To avoid causing bother, stay out of sight or keep your distance and don't mess about too much. The rate at which bother increases takes previous infringements into account. You can inspect enemies in ego mode to assess their attitude towards your current bot.
entries.translation: 警觉 某些行为不会立刻招来敌对反应， 但会引起警觉。 一旦敌人的警觉度达到100%， 视线内的安全宿主就会 被重新归类为不安全并遭到攻击。 想避免引起警觉，就避开视线、 保持距离，别太胡来。 警觉度的增长速率也会考虑 之前的违规行为。你可以在自我模式下 检视敌人，了解它对你当前机器人的态度。

entries.source: DAD Base DAD may conceal himself inside his DAD Base, emerging only in response to potential security threats. Before DAD emerges, you can take ctrl of the base to own it, meaning you alone can open it subsequently. DAD's juice replenishes automatically for as long as he remains at his base.
entries.translation: DAD基地 DAD可能藏在自己的基地里， 只有出现潜在安保威胁时才会出来。 在DAD现身前，你可以Ctrl基地， 将其占为己有。 之后就只有你能打开它了。 只要DAD待在基地里， 它的动力液就会自动补充。

entries.source: Disembodied In Ctrl Alt Ego, death is not the end. Your host may be toast, but you live on. Ctrl another host to continue your seamless simulated immersive experience. Thank you for your participation in this unavoidable scripted set-piece.
entries.translation: 脱离躯体 在Ctrl Alt Ego中，死亡并非终点。 宿主也许完蛋了，但你还活着。 Ctrl另一个宿主，继续享受 无缝衔接的沉浸式模拟体验。 感谢你参与这场 无可回避的预设剧情。

entries.source: Ego Mode Filtering You can use the Filter Wheel EMU add-on to help find and select sensors to ctrl. While in ego mode, check the controls info on left of the HUD to see how to open the filter wheel. You can also hit %Keyboard.EMUHideSensor% to filter out the currently selected sensor.

also influences movement speed.

<color=white>optional additional challenge.</color>

就说明当前区域已没有活跃的敌方机器人。

entries.source: Faulty Canisters Canisters catalyze all implosions they are caught up in, causing 'bonus' damage. Worm the Fault disk Canisters branch to turn faulting Canisters into even deadlier implosive devices.
entries.translation: 故障罐 罐体会强化它们卷入的内爆， 造成“额外”伤害。 向故障磁盘的罐体分支投入蠕虫， 就能让故障罐变成更加致命的内爆装置。

entries.source: Fault Use fault.exe to give objects faulting status. Shift faulting objects into hostiles to create a damaging implosion. Heavier objects make larger implosions.
entries.translation: 故障 使用fault.exe，使物体进入故障状态。 用移物将故障物体撞向敌人， 引发具有杀伤力的内爆。 物体越重，内爆规模越大。

entries.source:
Host Info
If you're unsure what a host does,
open your TAB/HOST page while in ctrl of it
to find supplementary information
that may or may not help.
entries.translation:
宿主信息
如果你不确定某个宿主的作用，
可以在 Ctrl 它时打开 TAB/宿主 页面，
查找可能有帮助（也可能没用）的
补充信息。

entries.source:
Hurry HOP
In Ego Mode, hurry HOP transfers between hosts
by keeping <color=white>■□□</color> held down
(or <color=white>RB</color> if you're using a controller).
entries.translation:
快速跃迁
在自我模式下，按住 <color=white>■□□</color>
（若使用手柄则是 <color=white>RB</color>）
即可在宿主之间快速进行跃迁。

entries.source: Husks When a host has been drained of all its energy, it transitions to a lifeless husk. You can revive husks for a modest energy cost. Husks have near zero mass which may or may not be interesting information.
entries.translation: 空壳 当宿主的所有能量被抽干时， 就会转变为毫无生气的 空壳。 你可以消耗少量能量来 复活空壳。 空壳的质量几乎为零， 这或许是有趣的信息，或许也不是。

entries.source: Implosions If you are wondering what implosions are, then the answer is that they're a bit like explosions, except not. You may not have encountered an implosion yet - don't worry - they're coming. Ethermatically speaking, an implosion is when matter collapses down near instantaneously to its data representation.
entries.translation: 内爆 如果你想知道什么是内爆， 答案是：有点像爆炸，但又不是。 也许你还没遇到过内爆。 别担心——快了。 用以太学的说法，内爆就是物质 在近乎一瞬间坍缩， 还原成它的数据形式。

entries.source: Insights Stuck? Need a hint? Try opening your TAB/TASK page and check your Insights (they appear lower-right). Note: If you don't want insights spoilering your simulated immersive experience you can disable them from the MainMenu / HUD Settings.
entries.translation: 洞察提示 卡关了？ 需要提示？ 不妨打开你的 TAB/任务 页面， 查看你的 洞察提示 （显示在右下角）。 注意： 如果你不希望提示剧透 破坏你的沉浸式模拟体验， 可以在主菜单 / HUD 设置中 将其禁用。

entries.source:
Computers
Computers often reveal useful information 
about the current area.

The simulated immersive experience can't know
to what extent you have read and understood the
information presented, so in most cases your EMU
will collate and retain the salient points 
on your behalf.
entries.translation:
电脑
电脑往往会提供
当前区域的有用信息。

沉浸式模拟体验无从判断你
究竟读懂了多少信息，
因此在大多数情况下，
EMU会替你整理并保留要点。

entries.source: Juice Bug disk programs run on Juice. Keep your HUD Juice Meter topped up by finding and drinking packets of Juice.
entries.translation: 动力液 BUG的磁盘程序靠动力液运行。 想让HUD上的动力液表保持充足， 就去寻找并饮用一包包动力液。

entries.source: No Bug If you lose your bug, these are your options: 1. Carry on without it 2. Rescue it 3. Reprint it from any available Bug Printer 4. Reload yourself from the Main Menu
entries.translation: 失去BUG 如果弄丢了BUG，你可以： 1. 没有它也照样继续 2. 去救它 3. 找一台可用的 BUG打印机重新打印它 4. 从主菜单 重新加载自己

entries.source:
MEM
Extract MEM from discarded Memory Cards.

Look out for distinctive 
<color=white>white vending machines</color>
to exchange your MEM 
for something more useful.
entries.translation:
MEM
从废弃的记忆卡中提取MEM。

留意那些醒目的
<color=white>白色自动售货机</color>，
可以用你的MEM兑换
更有用的物品。

entries.source: About METAs META info will appear here to help guide you through your Ctrl Alt Ego simulated immersive experience.
entries.translation: 关于指南 指南信息将显示在此处， 帮助引导你完成《Ctrl Alt Ego》 的模拟沉浸式体验。

entries.source:
Arm Physics
If your bug's arm is snagging on things
or just generally getting in the way,
try 'holstering' the current tool by 
<color=cyan>switching to the Grabber tool</color>.

You can set your own key-binding to
expedite a quick-switch to the Grabber
(MainMenu/Settings/Keyboard).
entries.translation:
机械臂物理特性
如果你的BUG的机械臂卡在物体上，
或者总是碍手碍脚，
可以尝试通过<color=cyan>切换至抓取器工具</color>
来“收起”当前工具。

你可以自行设置按键绑定，
以便快速切换至抓取器
（主菜单/设置/键盘）。

entries.source:
Bug Arm Tools
To equip a different arm tool, 
open the tool wheel.

Check the Controls UI (HUD left)
to see how.

You can create your own binding 
to bring up the tool wheel
(MainMenu/Settings/Key Bindings).

Tools can also be selected using their 
hot-key binding (also customisable).
entries.translation:
BUG机械臂工具
想换一种机械臂工具，
就打开工具轮盘。

具体操作请查看
HUD左侧的控制提示。

你可以自定义呼出工具轮盘的按键，
路径：主菜单/设置/按键绑定。

也可以用各工具的快捷键选择它们，
这些快捷键同样可以自定义。

entries.source: Bug Arm Your bug has a handy arm. The arm can Grab, Carry, Rotate, Upright and Throw lightweight objects. With an object grabbed, check the 'Controls HUD' on the left side of screen to see how to manipulate grabbed objects. The arm also comes equipped with a number of tools that can be activated by installing the appropriate program from disk.
entries.translation: BUG机械臂 你的BUG有一条很实用的机械臂。 它可以抓取、搬运、旋转、扶正和投掷 轻型物体。 抓住物体后，查看屏幕左侧的控制提示， 就能知道如何操作手里的物体。 机械臂还配有多种工具， 从磁盘安装相应程序即可启用。

entries.source:
Multi-Tasking
Multiple active TAB/Tasks do not have to be 
tackled in the order they appear.

If there is no immediately apparent way to
complete a task, try focusing on another until
new information is revealed.
entries.translation:
多重任务
多个处于激活状态的TAB/任务无需
按照出现顺序依次解决。

如果某个任务暂时没有明确的完成方法，
不妨先专注于另一个任务，
直到揭开新的线索。

entries.source:
Feeling nauseous?
Adjust motion/camera settings, including FOV:
Menu > Settings > Motion/Camera

Adjust Ego Mode effect intensity:
Menu > Settings > Display > More
entries.translation:
感到眩晕恶心？
调整移动/视角设置，包括视野（FOV）：
菜单 > 设置 > 移动/视角

调整自我模式特效强度：
菜单 > 设置 > 显示 > 更多

entries.source:
Network Sign-in
In some zones, security operates on a
private local area ego-network.

Before you can ctrl hosts on a secure
network you first need to acquire the
network username and password, and then
log-on at a local network switch.
entries.translation:
网络登录
某些区域的安保系统
使用专用的局域自我网络。

要Ctrl安全网络中的宿主，
你得先获取网络用户名和密码，
再到本地网络交换机上登录。

entries.source: Pacifist Optional - for advanced operators! Once a bot has been broken into bits, it's gone forever. If you believe conscious robots are people too, you might like to try to avoid breaking them up. Eliminate them through more reversible means, or avoid them altogether. To maintain a zero Broken Bots count, avoid breaking bots into bits. Includes Pups! Doesn't include Bug-traps, reprintable Bugs and Parasites/Viruses.
entries.translation: 和平主义者 可选挑战——适合高阶操作员！ 机器人一旦被打成碎片，就再也回不来了。 如果你相信有意识的机器人也是“人”， 不妨试着避免把它们打碎。 用可以挽回的方式摆平它们，或者干脆绕开。 想让损毁机器人的计数保持为零， 就别把机器人打成碎片。 PUP也算！BUG陷阱不算， 可重新打印的BUG、寄生虫和病毒也不算。

entries.source:
Turd in the pipe
Oh very droll.
You've managed to stuff a MUM inside a pipe.

The developers want you to know this is not an
oversight, but entirely intended behaviour.
We couldn't think of a benefit to doing it,
and we could have prevented it, but we reckoned
we'd leave it up to you.

If you fancy a challenge, now try to extricate
her from the pipe.
entries.translation:
管道里的堵头
噢，真滑稽。
你居然把一只MUM塞进了管道里。

开发者在此声明，这绝非疏忽，
完全是有意为之的行为。
我们想不出这么做有什么好处，
原本也能加以阻止，但我们觉得
还是交由你自己决定吧。

如果你想找点挑战，现在试试
把她从管道里弄出来吧。

entries.source:
Developments
You can view a summary of the plot
on your TAB/TASK page.

It's also shown while experiencing the
curious temporal interference during
transition between locations.

So if you feel somewhat aggrieved at the 
plot summary rudely disappearing before 
you were able to finish reading it,
1. Be grateful you have a fast CPU
2. Catch up in your TAB!
entries.translation:
剧情进展
你可以在TAB的任务页
查看剧情梗概。

切换区域、经历那种古怪的
时间干扰时，也会显示剧情梗概。

所以，如果还没读完，
剧情梗概就粗鲁地消失，让你心有不满：
1. 庆幸自己有颗速度够快的CPU吧
2. 去TAB里补读！

entries.source:
Home HOP to Bug 22
If there is a viable HOP route back to Bug 22
Execute a quick home HOP to Bug 22
by hitting %Keyboard.QuickHopToMainBug% while in Ego Mode
(or %Gamepad.QuickHopToMainBug% if using a controller).
entries.translation:
返家跃迁至BUG 22
如果存在返回BUG 22的可行跃迁路线，
在自我模式下按下%Keyboard.QuickHopToMainBug%
（若使用手柄则为%Gamepad.QuickHopToMainBug%），
即可执行快速返家跃迁至BUG 22。

entries.source:
Return HOP
If there is a viable HOP route
back to your last host
execute a quick return HOP to it
by hitting %Keyboard.QuickHopToLastHost% while in Ego Mode
(or %Gamepad.QuickHopToLastHost% if using a controller).
entries.translation:
返回跃迁
如果存在通往上一个宿主的可行跃迁路线，
在自我模式下按%Keyboard.QuickHopToLastHost%
（使用手柄则按%Gamepad.QuickHopToLastHost%），
就能快速跃迁回那个宿主。

entries.source:
Print Fee
If your bug is trapped inside a DAD,
re-printing your bug incurs a release fee.

The fee is calculated as a percentage of your
total ego, and scales with game diffiulty.

To avoid the fee, consider staging an heroic
bug rescue by ctrl-ing or eliminating DAD!
entries.translation:
重印费用
如果你的BUG被困在DAD体内，
重新打印BUG将产生一笔释放费。

该费用按你自我总量的百分比计算，
并随游戏难度递增。

若想免去这笔费用，不妨尝试通过Ctrl
或消灭DAD，来上演一场英勇的救援行动！

entries.source: Safe When you first ctrl a host, it is marked Safe. A Safe host is not considered a threat and will not be attacked. Avoid bothering hostiles to keep your host Safe. Your host's Safe status is shown in your HUD.
entries.translation: 安全 当你首次Ctrl某个宿主时，它会被标记为安全。 处于安全状态的宿主不被视为威胁， 也不会遭受攻击。 避免引起敌对目标警觉，以保持宿主的安全状态。 宿主的安全状态会显示在你的HUD中。

entries.source: Life Saver Save your game as often as you like at Life Saver points. Automatic 'checkpoint' saves are also made as you progress. Load any save back in from the Main Menu (Esc).
entries.translation: 救生器 在救生器点随时保存你的游戏进度， 想存多少次都可以。 随着游戏推进，系统也会 自动进行“检查点”存档。 可随时从主菜单（Esc） 读取任何存档。

entries.source: Serialization Ethermatics is the branch of physics that describes material -> data and data -> material transformations. By taking ctrl of a Serializer you can serialize and deserialize ("print") local ethermatic objects. To facilitate identification, an energy readout is displayed when looking at ethermatic objects.
entries.translation: 序列化 以太学是描述“物质 -> 数据”以及“数据 -> 物质” 转化的物理学分支。 通过 ctrl 一台序列化机， 你可以对本地以太学物品进行序列化 和反序列化（“打印”）。 为方便识别，注视以太学物品时 会显示其能量读数。

entries.source: Stats & Achievements As you gain experience you might like to challenge yourself to try adopting a Pacifist, Unidentified or Executor playstyle. Or for even greater interest, combine them. See the corresponding META for each that just triggered for more details.
entries.translation: 统计数据与成就 随着经验的积累，你或许想 挑战一下自己，尝试和平主义者、 未被识别或执行者玩法。 或者将它们结合起来，体验更多乐趣。 详情请查看刚刚触发的各项对应 指南。

entries.source:
Stealth
You can usually avoid detection by 
approaching situations strategically.

Not being seen has several benefits,
including not being shot at.

Skilled operators can conserve resources 
by nipping past hostiles without engaging
them at all.
entries.translation:
潜行
通过策略性地应对各种情况，
你通常可以避免被发现。

不被看见有诸多好处，
包括不挨枪子。

熟练的操作员可以通过从敌对目标身边溜过
而完全不与其交火，以此节省资源。

entries.source: Unbreakable Like Mr Bossman, various hosts in Ctrl Alt Ego can be broken apart. Curiously however, Bug 0 is unbreakable. Indeed it is foretold that The Chosen Developer will one day rise up and finally crack Bug 0. But until that time, Bug 0 remains unbreakable.
entries.translation: 不可破坏 和老板先生一样，Ctrl Alt Ego 中的各种宿主 都可以被拆解击碎。 但奇怪的是，BUG 0 是不可破坏的。 确实有预言称，天选开发者 终有一日会挺身而出，彻底解决 BUG 0。 但在那一天到来之前，BUG 0 依然不可破坏。

entries.source: Unidentified Attempt to remain unidentified for optional additional challenge. To maintain a zero Identifications count, avoid being seen in unsafe hosts. You can still attack and make noise, just don't be seen. Be creative! There are many different tricks and strategies available to you. You can enable a HUD alert to signal when you're identified (see HUD Settings/More).
entries.translation: 未被识别 尝试保持未被识别状态，以迎接 可选的额外挑战。 要想保持“被识别”次数为零， 请避免在处于不安全宿主中时被看见。你依然可以 攻击并制造噪音，只要别被看见就行。 发挥创意吧！有许多不同的技巧 和策略可供你使用。 你可以开启 HUD 警报，以便在被识别时 收到提示（参见 HUD 设置/更多）。

entries.source: Unsafe Your bug is not supposed to be here and is considered Unsafe. Unsafe hosts are attacked on sight. Your host's Unsafe status is shown in your HUD.
entries.translation: 不安全 你的 BUG 本不该出现在这里， 因此被视作不安全。 处于不安全状态的宿主一旦被发现便会遭到攻击。 宿主的不安全状态会显示在你的 HUD 中。

entries.source:
Clad DAD
Turns out Mr Bossman was just a clad DAD.
Once denuded, I can ctrl clad DADs 
in the usual way.
entries.translation:
装甲DAD
原来老板先生只是个披着装甲的DAD。
除去装甲后，我就能像平常那样
Ctrl这些DAD了。

entries.source:
Bug Bits
Dr Everyman says he'll notify me 
when I've found enough bug bits.
entries.translation:
BUG 碎片
埃弗里曼博士说，等我收集到足够的
BUG 碎片时，他会通知我。

entries.source:
Compare
I can compare DADs in ego mode 
to plan my assault.
entries.translation:
对比
我可以在自我模式下对比各个 DAD，
以此规划我的进攻。

entries.source:
Cover
I can exploit DADs to create cover
and block enemy lines of sight.
entries.translation:
掩体
我可以利用 DAD 来制造掩体，
遮挡敌人的视线。

entries.source:
Merge Authorization
I found a Legacy Merge Authorization
token. Perhaps I can use it somehow to
gain access to the Merging Station?
entries.translation:
合并授权
我找到了一个旧版合并授权令牌。
也许我能用它想办法
进入合并站？

entries.source:
'Teleport'
I can exploit DADs to 'teleport' my hosts
around to access out of reach areas.
entries.translation:
“传送”
我可以利用 DAD 将我的宿主四处“传送”，
以此进入难以企及的区域。

entries.source:
Debugger Key
There is likely more than one copy
of the debugger key.
entries.translation:
调试器钥匙
调试器钥匙很可能
不止一把。

entries.source:
Bach
Pups can bach to distract DADs
entries.translation:
鸣叫（巴赫）
PUP 可以通过鸣叫来分散 DAD 的注意力

entries.source:
Rocket Damage
It might be worth reviewing my
Aeronautics WORM options.
entries.translation:
火箭冲刺伤害
或许值得检查一下我的
航空学蠕虫升级选项。

entries.source:
Need weapon?
Perhaps I can install a new program
to give me more options?
entries.translation:
需要武器？
也许我可以安装一个新程序
来为自己提供更多选择？

entries.source:
See-through
DADs can't see through see-through things
entries.translation:
透明
DAD看不到透明物体后面的东西

entries.source:
Ctrl Alt
Perhaps I can ctrl DADs
and use them against each other?
entries.translation:
Ctrl Alt
也许我可以ctrl DAD，
让他们自相残杀？

entries.source:
Evil Eyes
Evil Eyes might be damageable.
entries.translation:
恶魔之眼
恶魔之眼或许是可以被破坏的。

entries.source:
Bug Free Zone
I mean... it's clearly a trap.
But this is only the prologue,
there's no way to avoid it.
Perhaps Dr Everyman wants to
show me something important?
entries.translation:
无BUG区
我的意思是……这显然是个陷阱。
但这只是序章，
根本没办法避开它。
也许埃弗里曼博士想
给我看些重要的东西？

entries.source:
CAT
Perhaps the CAT needs
a good kick up the arse?
entries.translation:
CAT
也许这台CAT需要
狠狠地踢上一脚？

entries.source:
Expose Sensor
I probably need a bug for this bit.
Where's the nearest bug-printer?
entries.translation:
暴露传感器
这部分我可能需要一只BUG。
最近的BUG打印机在哪？

entries.source: Expose Sensor I may be able to use Rocket to expose Mr Bossman's sensor.
entries.translation: 暴露传感器 我或许可以用火箭冲刺 来让老板先生的传感器暴露出来。

entries.source:
Expose Sensor
I may be able to use my grabber 
to expose Mr Bossman's sensor.
entries.translation:
暴露传感器
我或许可以用抓取器
来让老板先生的传感器暴露出来。

entries.source:
Friendly Ego
To grow my ego I should use ego mode 
to look for friendly hosts to ctrl.
entries.translation:
友好自我
为了壮大自我，我应该使用自我模式
去寻找友好的宿主进行ctrl。

entries.source:
Hostile Ego
I can 'spend' ego to ctrl secure/hostile
hosts, so long as my ego is at least
as large as their's.
entries.translation:
敌意自我
我可以“消耗”自我来ctrl受保护/敌对的
宿主，只要我的自我至少
和他们的一样庞大。

entries.source:
Ego
I need to retrace my steps to grow my ego.
A HOP back to a Bug Printer may help?
entries.translation:
自我
我需要原路返回来壮大自我。
跃迁回BUG打印机或许会有帮助？

entries.source:
HOP round corners
I can HOP back to my Bug from
pretty much anywhere.
entries.translation:
绕角跃迁
我几乎可以从任何地方
跃迁回我的BUG。

entries.source:
Shoot
If only there were a DAD nearby to shoot
those big fat crates out of existence.
entries.translation:
射击
要是附近有个DAD能把
那些大胖箱子轰得渣都不剩就好了。

entries.source:
Bugs
I need to look for bugs to feed into
the Consciousness Ctrl Stream.
entries.translation:
BUG
我需要寻找BUG并送入
意识Ctrl流中。

entries.source:
Hidey-Hole
There's a sneaky hidey-hole
somewhere near the subway entrance.
entries.translation:
藏身处
地铁入口附近的某个地方
有个隐蔽的藏身处。

entries.source:
Psychoethermatosis
Am I inside a computer program?
entries.translation:
精神以太病
我是在电脑程序里吗？

entries.source:
Signal Box
I can open rail side branches by 
ctrl-ing the appropriate signal box.
entries.translation:
信号箱
我可以操控（ctrl）对应的信号箱，
来开启轨道支线。

entries.source:
Underrail
It might be possible to access
the station underrail area.
entries.translation:
轨下区域
也许能进入
车站的轨下区域。

entries.source:
Doors
Closing doors may help me stay safe.
entries.translation:
门
随手关门也许能让我保住小命。

entries.source:
MUM
Apparently if I mess with MUM then 
another MUM will just take her place.
entries.translation:
MUM
显然，如果我招惹了MUM，
就会有另一台MUM直接顶替她。

entries.source:
Undercover
If I don't cause any bother, I can get
around safely in a Safe MUM.
entries.translation:
伪装
只要我不惹麻烦，就能待在安全的
MUM里到处晃悠。

entries.source: Virtual It might be possible to sneak my bug around using the Virtual program.
entries.translation: 虚拟 或许可以使用Virtual（虚拟）程序 让我的BUG四处潜行。

entries.source:
Safety
The parasite can't see me
at safe hosts.
entries.translation:
安全
寄生体看不到处于
安全宿主内的我。

entries.source:
Disks
Disks provide new Bug abilities.
entries.translation:
磁盘
磁盘可为BUG提供新能力。

entries.source:
Juice
Disk programs are fueled by juice
entries.translation:
动力液
磁盘程序需要消耗动力液来运行

entries.source:
The Gift Of Flight
Why am I using the lift?
I can fly! I can bloody fly!
entries.translation:
飞行的天赋
我干嘛要乘电梯？
我会飞啊！我他妈会飞！

entries.source:
Rocket
I may be able Rocket myself into
obstacles to smash through them.
entries.translation:
火箭冲刺
我也许可以用火箭冲刺撞向障碍物，
把它们统统撞碎。

蠕虫
蠕虫能改良磁盘程序。

entries.source:
Serialize Pup
I suppose I could always try 
shooting Pup in the face?
entries.translation:
序列化PUP
我想我大可以试着
朝PUP的脸上开一枪？

entries.source:
Insights
Stuck? Need a hint?
<color=green>Insights will appear here!</color>
entries.translation:
洞察提示
卡关了？想要提示？
<color=green>洞察提示会显示在这里！</color>

entries.source:
Print Pup
There's a message at the bottom
of my HUD that seems to be
trying to tell me something.
entries.translation:
打印PUP
我的HUD底部有一条消息，
似乎想告诉我些什么。

entries.source:
Maggot Detector
There's a maggot detector somewhere,
possibly above the first loading bay.
entries.translation:
蛆虫探测器
某处有个蛆虫探测器，
可能就在第一个装卸区上方。

entries.source:
Maggots
GOD modules can be compromised
by feeding maggots to them.
entries.translation:
蛆虫
向GOD模块喂食蛆虫
可以削弱其功能。

entries.source:
Parasite Modules
The parasite is running GOD modules 
to boost its defences.
entries.translation:
寄生体模块
寄生体正在运行GOD模块
以增强其防御。

entries.source:
Bug Key
PAM from Science hid the key to Bug 0 
"at the accident site".
entries.translation:
BUG钥匙
科学部门的PAM把BUG 0的钥匙
藏在了“事故现场”。

entries.source:
Bug
PAM mentioned she's placed a bug under 
observation in Science.
entries.translation:
BUG
PAM提到她在科学部门
放置了一个接受观察的BUG。

entries.source:
Ghost
I remember seeing a message from PAM
about catching The Executor unawares
by remaining unidentified.
entries.translation:
幽灵
我记得见过PAM发来的一条消息，
说可以通过保持未被识别的状态
杀执行者一个措手不及。

entries.source:
Executor's Private Quarters
The key to The Executor's private 
residence is inside his brain.
entries.translation:
执行者的私人住所
进入执行者私人住所的钥匙
就在他的大脑里。

entries.source:
Engineering
Dr Everyman mentioned I may be able to
to take the lift down to Engineering.
entries.translation:
工程部门
埃弗里曼博士提到我也许可以
乘电梯下去前往工程部门。

entries.source:
Vents
There are ceiling vents throughout
the techlab.
entries.translation:
通风管道
科技实验室各处的天花板
都有通风管道。

entries.source:
Lost CAT
I saw some strange eyepad waffle
about concealing CATs in drawers.
entries.translation:
走失的CAT
我在EyePad 平板上看到些奇怪的闲话，
说是要把CAT藏在抽屉里。

entries.source:
The Executor
The Executor is running CRS from 
the Corporate level.
entries.translation:
执行者
执行者正在行政区
掌控着CRS。

entries.source:
The Executor
Someone or something called 'The 
Executor' is running CRS.
entries.translation:
执行者
某个被称为“执行者”的人或事物
正在掌控CRS。

entries.source:
Ctrl Script
It might be possible to wipe The 
Executor's ego by running the ctrl
script on his PC.
entries.translation:
Ctrl脚本
或许可以通过在他电脑上运行ctrl
脚本，来抹除执行者的自我。

entries.source:
Dr Everyman's Office
Dr Everyman may have hidden something in 
his old Tech Lab office on the 2nd floor.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士的办公室
埃弗里曼博士可能把什么东西藏在了
他位于2楼的旧科技实验室办公室里。

entries.source:
Dr Everyman's Office
Dr Everyman used to work in the Tech Lab.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士的办公室
埃弗里曼博士过去曾在科技实验室工作。

entries.source:
PAM
PAM from science says she's found 
a really strange old bug.
entries.translation:
PAM
科学部门的PAM说她找到了
一只非常奇怪的旧BUG。

entries.source:
PAM
There's someone named 'PAM'. From Science.
entries.translation:
PAM
有个叫“PAM”的人。来自科学部门。

entries.source:
Cafeteria Access
There's a ceiling vent from Dorm 02
to the cafeteria
entries.translation:
进入食堂
02号宿舍的天花板通风口
通往食堂

entries.source:
POD Access
Apparently PUPs can access PODs 
through their roofs.
entries.translation:
进入POD的途径
显然PUP可以通过POD的
顶部进入其中。

entries.source:
Thank you 
for helping yourself 
to my archived data.
entries.translation:
感谢你
擅自随意取用
我的归档数据。

entries.source:
Here,
Have an energy cell
on me.

Well okay not on me,
more like *in* you.
In your bots,
in each and every one of them.
entries.translation:
喏，
这块能量电池算我
请你的。

好吧，其实也不是算我头上，
更像是装在*你*身上。
装在你的机器人里，
它们每一个的身上。

entries.source:
May your beams be big and bad.

I once knew a guy
who installed many of me
so that he could stay safe
while frying his prey
near-instantaneously.

What a guy.
entries.translation:
愿你的光束又大又猛。

我曾经认识一个家伙，
他安装了许多我这样的装置，
以便在近乎瞬间烤熟猎物的同时
确保自身的安全。

真是个人才。

entries.source:
To sit
is to understand.

May you be seated here
even if for merely a fleeting moment.

Download yourself.

Comprehend.
entries.translation:
安坐
方能领悟。

愿你在此就坐，
哪怕只是短暂的一瞬。

下载你自己吧。

然后去理解。

entries.source:
I'm a bug, so I'm banned.

By official decree.

From the office of The Executor.

In fact, if you are reading this
then you are breaking the law.

Un-ctrl me immediately and 
hand yourself in to the
nearest ego retention facility.
entries.translation:
我是BUG，所以我被取缔了。

这是正式颁布的法令。

由执行者办公室发布。

事实上，只要你在读这些话，
你就已经触犯了法律。

请立刻解除对我的Ctrl，
并前往最近的自我拘留所自首。

entries.source:
I toast bugs.

I toast them good and proper.

So bring me bugs
and I'll make you some toast.

However, I'd just like to clarify:
I'm absolutely *not*
a repurposed toaster.
entries.translation:
我烘烤BUG。

我把它们烤得又香又脆。

所以给我带BUG来，
我就给你烤几片吐司。

不过，我还是想澄清一下：
我绝对*不是*
一台改装过的烤面包机。

entries.source:
I shuttle
back and forth
to and fro
from thither to hither
that is what I do
got a problem with that?
entries.translation:
我来回穿梭
从这头到那头
从彼处到此方
这就是我的工作
你有意见？

entries.source:
I am CCTV.

I can see
what you can see.
entries.translation:
我是闭路电视监控。

我能看见
你所看见的一切。

entries.source:
I'm a Ctrl Alt Terminal 
or CAT
the communications device of choice
for the discerning ego.

Integrated text and audio communications
are among two of my three advanced features.
entries.translation:
我是Ctrl Alt终端，
也就是CAT，
是有品味的自我的首选通信设备。

集成式文本与音频通信，
仅是我三大先进功能中的两项。

entries.source:
I'm an egocentric 
management tier unit 
with the authority 
and means
to serialize
and/or deserialize 
ethermaterial objects.

Now please relinquish ctrl of me
and file an urgent ego reset request
with the egonomics department.
entries.translation:
我是一个以自我为中心的
管理层单位，
拥有将以太物质对象
进行序列化
和/或反序列化的
权限与手段。

现在请交出对我的Ctrl权，
并向自我管理部
提交一份紧急自我重置申请。

entries.source:
I hereby grant you 
full and exclusive access
to my DAD chute aperture.
entries.translation:
我特此授予你
进入我DAD滑道开口的
完全独家访问权限。

entries.source:
I regret to inform you 
that as yet 
I haven't uploaded
any supplementary information 
for myself.
entries.translation:
很遗憾地通知你，
截至目前，
我还没有为自己上传
任何补充信息。

entries.source:
Hang on
Just spinning up my disk
to see if I have anything of interest
to impart to you here

No.
Nothing.
Sorry.
entries.translation:
稍等
我正在启动磁盘，
看看这里有没有什么有趣的信息
能传授给你

没有。
啥都没有。
不好意思。

entries.source:
Error 3

Host not found.

To fix this, please ctrl something.
entries.translation:
错误 3

未找到宿主。

若要修复此问题，请Ctrl某个物体。

entries.source:
I open.
I close.
Well sometimes I close, sometimes not.

I sincerely hope that one day 
they restore you as a DOR
so that you too can witness first-hand 
the exhilerating prospect of opening 
and sometimes closing 
at the behest of other less constricted
but patently less intelligent egos.
entries.translation:
我开。
我关。
好吧，有时我关，有时不关。

我衷心希望有朝一日
他们也能将你恢复成一扇DOR，
这样你也能亲身领略
在那些行动更自由、
但智力显然更低下的自我驱使下，
开门，以及偶尔关门
这一令人兴奋的美好前景。

entries.source: 0x00 Null Pointer Exception. Variable egg has not been assigned.
entries.translation: 0x00 空指针异常（Null Pointer Exception）。 变量 egg 尚未赋值。

entries.source:
Hello,
I'm the Executive of Administrative Affairs
or for those that knew me before:
It's me, Gareth.

It's my job to make public announcements, 
proclamations and decrees on behalf 
of The Executor.

Do pop up to my office up on the Corporate level
and say howdy. 

I don't really need the office
since I transitioned, but I still like to think
of it as home.
entries.translation:
你好，
我是行政事务主管，
或者对于那些以前认识我的人来说：
是我，加雷斯（Gareth）。

我的职责是代表执行者发布
公开通告、
公告和法令。

有空的话请随时顺道来行政区的办公室，
打个招呼吧。

自从形态转变之后，我其实
不需要办公室了，但我还是喜欢把那里
当作自己的家。

entries.source:
Ah sweet music.
Gentle nourishment for your ego.
entries.translation:
啊，美妙的音乐。
为你的自我奉上温柔滋养。

entries.source:
Some say I am grotesquely inefficient,
converting archived ego dump data 
to live ego fragments 
at a rate of 100YB 
to one spewed fragment.
entries.translation:
有人说我极其低效，
将归档的自我转储数据
转换为活体自我碎片，
转化比率居然高达100YB
换区区一枚喷吐出的碎片。

entries.source: Listen, I'm not evil at all I resent the marketing department for that. Yes it's true, my operating parameters require me to scan for bugs, issues and potential hazards. And yes it's true my programming mandates that I report to the nearest MUM or DAD. But I don't revel in my work, I don't enjoy it. I do it for survival. It's this or be redeployed as a DOR. Sorry.
entries.translation: 听着， 我一点也不邪恶， 这都怪市场部，我讨厌他们。 是的没错，我的运行参数要求我 扫描BUG、问题和潜在隐患。 是的没错，我的程序指令强制要求 我向最近的MUM或DAD报告。 但我并不热衷于工作，我并不享受它。 我这么做只是为了谋生。 要么这样，要么就被重新部署为一扇DOR。 对不住了。

entries.source:
Welcome!

I am a mark in time.

Have you made yours yet?
entries.translation:
欢迎！

我是时间中的印记。

你留下你的印记了吗？

entries.source:
Firewall stop/start service
at your
er
service.
entries.translation:
防火墙停止/启动服务
竭
呃
诚为您服务。

entries.source:
Erm
While you're here,
Can I ask a small favour of you?

Put me back on my bug body?
Please?
I know I'm suppose to have been banned,
but it's plain
you're not letting that deter you.
entries.translation:
呃
既然你都来了，
我能求你帮个小忙吗？

能把我放回我的BUG身体上吗？
拜托了？
我知道我本该被封禁的，
但显然
你并没有因此退缩。

entries.source:
Fair enough, I admit:
I used to be a lot more useful.

There was a time where the only
way you could speed up your HOPs
was to purchase me.

But too many operators complained
HOPs were too slow, and so 
HOPs got sped up anyway.

I still speed up secure overrides though
so I'm not entirely redundant.
entries.translation:
好吧，我承认：
我以前可有用得多了。

曾经有一段时间，加快你跃迁速度的
唯一办法
就是购买我。

但太多操作员抱怨
跃迁太慢了，所以
跃迁反正都提速了。

不过我仍能加快
对受保护传感器的越权控制，
所以我还不算完全多余。

entries.source:
Look,
stop your complaining!
I've given you one whole
additional juice compartment
at every bot you ctrl now
and in the future.

No, don't ask how that is possible
- something about "video games".

I do so hope you enjoy
your extra juice storage.
entries.translation:
听着，
别抱怨了！
无论你现在还是将来Ctrl的
每一个机器人，
我都为你额外增加了一整个
动力液储存舱。

不，别问这怎么可能做到
——大概和“电子游戏”之类的有关吧。

真希望你能喜欢
你额外的动力液储存空间。

entries.source:
I vend the etherelectrolytic fluids 
more commonly known as jus.

I don't vend anything else.
Jus' jus.
entries.translation:
我售卖那种通常被称为汁液（jus）的
以太电解液。

我不卖别的任何东西。
就（jus'）卖汁液。

entries.source:
Aha!
Caught you!
Trying to gain access, were you?

You naughty naughty ego.
I can't believe the young egos of today,
always thinking you have a GOD-given right
to access my secure resources.

How dare you.
Now GO.
Get out of my sight.
entries.translation:
啊哈！
抓到你了！
想获取访问权限，对吧？

你这个调皮捣蛋的自我。
真不敢相信现在的年轻自我，
总觉得访问我的安全资源
是你们的天赋神权。

你怎么敢的。
现在立刻走开。
从我眼前消失。

entries.source:
Yes, you probably already understand
I'm an elevating device
more properly known
as a LIFT.

I can't promise you the ride of your life
but I can get you from A to B,
so long as A is vertically 
but not horizontally 
displaced from B.
entries.translation:
是的，你可能已经明白了
我是一个提升装置，
更正式的称呼是
电梯（LIFT）。

我不能保证能让你体验人生最刺激的旅程，
但我可以把你从A点送到B点，
只要A点和B点之间
只有垂直位移
而没有水平位移即可。

entries.source:
Hello.

Would you like me to call the lift for you?
entries.translation:
你好。

需要我帮你叫电梯吗？

entries.source:
Oh.
You came to unlock me, did you?

Oh well.
Fine.
I suppose it was bound to happen
eventually.
entries.translation:
噢。
你是来解锁我的，对吧？

好吧。
行吧。
我想这迟早
都是要发生的。

entries.source:
I'm a Luggage Bot.
I lug bits and bots around and about.
entries.translation:
我是一个行李机器人。
我到处拖运各种零碎杂物和机器人。

entries.source:
A small charge
for a big recharge.

I'll gladly help keep any and all of
your energy-driven hosts in pristine shape.

Just point me at 'em.

Oh yeh, I've also got an auto-mode
for unctrl'd ongoing localised repair jobs.
Check out the controls UI baby.
entries.translation:
充入一点电荷，
收获充沛能量。

我很乐意帮你把你那群
耗能宿主全都维持在完美状态。

只要把我对准他们就行。

噢对了，我还有一个自动模式，
能在不受Ctrl时执行持续的局部维修作业。
去瞧瞧控制界面吧，宝贝。

entries.source:
I am motor.
I used to be more than that.
Much much more.

But this is my life now.
This.

Please let me spin in peace.
Afford me that small mercy,
I beseech you.
entries.translation:
我是一台马达。
我曾经不止于此。
远不止于此。

但这就是我如今的生活。
就这。

求求你让我安安静静地旋转吧。
行行好吧，赐我这一点微薄的仁慈，
我恳求你。

entries.source:
Before you ctrl'd me,
I was an autonomous
mobile unit
equipped with a devastating 
ethermaterial husker beam.

You ought to have procured the 
appropriate security clearance 
before ctrl-ing me.

You must comply fully with 
standard operating protocols 
while in possession of me.
entries.translation:
在你Ctrl我之前，
我是一个配备了毁灭性
以太物质抽空光束的
自主移动单元。

在Ctrl我之前，
你本该先获取
相应的安全许可。

占用我期间，
你必须完全遵守
标准操作规范。

entries.source:
Greetings, user.

Egonet is my name,
resource location and uploading is my game.
entries.translation:
你好，用户。

自我网络是我的名字，
资源定位和上传是我的本事。

entries.source:
Words

Words here
Words there
More words here
and there.

Words words words.

Words with meaning
Words without
That's what words are all about.
entries.translation:
文字

这里的文字
那里的文字
这里还有更多文字
还有那里。

文字文字文字。

有意义的文字
毫无意义的文字
文字就是这么回事。

entries.source:
Welcome
to the main menu editor

Please customise the main menu
from the myriad options presented.
entries.translation:
欢迎来到
主菜单编辑器

请从提供的
无数选项中自定义主菜单。

entries.source: I'm not surprised to see you here.
entries.translation: 看到你在这里，我一点也不意外。

entries.source:
I display words
on a screen
for you to skip
or perhaps worse:
to under-appreciate.

That said
the very fact you're reading this
tells me something about you.

I think I like you.
Thanks for stopping by.
entries.translation:
我在屏幕上
显示文字
供你跳过
或者更糟：
不屑一顾。

话虽如此
你正在阅读这段话的事实
就足以让我对你有所了解。

我想我喜欢你。
感谢停留。

entries.source:
When you've finished stealing everyone's ego,
perhaps you might like to 
ask yourself the question:

Who is the real parasite?
entries.translation:
当你窃取完全部人的自我时，
也许你该试着
问问自己这个问题：

到底谁才是真正的寄生虫？

entries.source:
Perform.
Monitor.
Quantify.
Appraise.
Evaluate.
Inform.
entries.translation:
执行。
监控。
量化。
评定。
评估。
告知。

entries.source:
Welcome, friend.
I am the friendliest robot
in the whole wide 
simulated immersive experience.

Thanks for erasing me from history 
by wiping my ego 
and taking it for yourself.

I have served my purpose.
I hope you in turn
will serve yours.
entries.translation:
欢迎，朋友。
我是整个广袤的
沉浸式模拟体验中
最友善的机器人。

谢谢你抹除我的自我
并据为己有，
从而将我从历史上抹去。

我已经完成了我的使命。
希望你也能
完成你的。

entries.source:
I switch.
It's what I do.
On/Off
Open/Close
This/That

Thanks.

Now get on with it
and bugger off.
entries.translation:
我负责开关。
这就是我的工作。
开/关
启/闭
这个/那个

谢谢。

现在赶紧办正事去，
然后滚蛋吧。

entries.source:
I print Pups
don't you know.
entries.translation:
我是打印PUP的，
你不知道吗。

entries.source:
Failure is unpossible.

Dr Everyman re-jigged my 
emergency employee evacuation chamber
and converted me into a 
fully functioning bug printer.

I only print Bug 22, mind you.
I'm not sure why, precisely.

Something to do with something about 
unidirectional linear ethermatics, I think.
entries.translation:
失败是绝不可能的。

埃弗里曼博士改造了我的
员工紧急疏散舱，
把我变成了一台
功能完备的BUG打印机。

不过，提醒你一下，我只打印BUG 22。
具体原因我也说不准。

大概和某种单向线性以太学有关吧，我想。

entries.source:
I come equipped with 
a state of the art floppy disk drive
and offer a 
safe,
secure, 
physical 
data transfer capability.
entries.translation:
我配备了
最先进的软盘驱动器，
可提供
安全、
可靠的
物理
数据传输功能。

entries.source:
If I may,
I'd very much like 
to scramble your ego.

There,
done it.

Your unique ego signature
should now be a little 
trickier to identify.
entries.translation:
如果可以的话，
我很想
扰乱你的自我。

好啦，
搞定。

你独一无二的自我特征码
现在应该更难
被识别了。

entries.source:
Eye spy
with my little eye
alternative routes
hostile deployments
resources.

But most of all,
Eye spy
opportunity.
entries.translation:
我侦测到，
用我敏锐的眼睛：
替代路线、
敌方部署、
资源。

但最重要的是，
我侦测到了
机遇。

entries.source:
I'm a big fat crate
with a convenient 
self-loading
capability.

Simply trigger my 
onboard 
self-serialization
mechanism
to load me 
onto my designated carrier.
entries.translation:
我是一个大胖板条箱，
拥有方便的
自主装载
功能。

只需触发我
机载的
自主序列化
机制，
就能将我装载
到指定的运输工具上。

entries.source:
I'm a '90s phone
Can't you tell?
With advanced SMS capabilities.
entries.translation:
我是部90年代的手机，
看不出来吗？
拥有先进的短信功能。

entries.source:
I capture snaps of cool cats.
Are you a cool cat?
Hit the button and let's find out.

Ah but to landscape or to portrait,
is the question.

Just fekkin get on with it,
is the answer.
entries.translation:
我专门抓拍酷家伙。
你是酷家伙吗？
按个按钮瞧瞧吧。

啊，但该横拍还是竖拍呢，
这是个问题。

赶紧他妈的拍就完事了，
这是答案。

entries.source:
Please load up
the secure holding area
with useful hosts
while I establish
a secure connection
to the adjoining area.
entries.translation:
请在安全停放区
装入实用的宿主，
与此同时我将建立
通往相邻区域的
安全连接。

entries.source:
Thank you for choosing to ctrl the
TAB Task Activity Broker.

Enjoy seamless EMU integration,
enhanced communications,
host extensions and more.

All at a tap of your tab.
entries.translation:
感谢选择Ctrl
TAB任务活动代理。

尽享无缝EMU集成、
增强通信、
宿主扩展等诸多功能。

一切只需轻按TAB。

entries.source:
Mistakes will be made
(though not by me).

It's crucial to carry out rigorous testing
to find mistakes
and remedy them
before anyone discovers how thick you were.
entries.translation:
错误在所难免
（虽然不是我犯的）。

进行严格测试至关重要，
这样才能发现错误
并予以纠正，
免得让人发现你有多笨。

entries.source:
I'm a toy
A humble toy.

Would you let your child
play with a ctrlable toy?
entries.translation:
我是个玩具，
一个不起眼的玩具。

你会让自己的孩子
玩一个可Ctrl的玩具吗？

entries.source:
I'm a train
A space train.

My route extends 
all the way from
The Cloud to The Core,
but for the purposes of your story
I'm confined to the merging station
where you may observe 
my different branches
unify into one.
entries.translation:
我是一列火车，
一列太空火车。

我的路线从
云端一路延伸到核心，
但就你的故事而言，
我仅限于合并站内，
在那里你可以观察到
我的各条支线
汇聚为一。

entries.source:
All hail me
a GOD upgrade module.
The first of its kind.
Not the first?
The second perhaps?
Okay, the three-hundredth.
I'm okay with that if you are.
entries.translation:
向我致敬吧，
一个GOD升级模块。
史无前例的杰作。
不是第一个？
也许是第二个？
好吧，第三百个。
要是你没意见，我也无所谓。

entries.source:
I'm not easy to see
but I usually have a good view.
entries.translation:
我不太容易被看见，
但我通常视野绝佳。

entries.source: Like a parasite, only not a boss.
entries.translation: 像个寄生虫，只是算不上老大。
对未察觉的目标效果最佳

entries.source:
Float, thrust and ultimately
rocket around.

Can be upgraded to turn your bug
into a speeding bullet, dealing
stun and/or physical damage.
entries.translation:
悬浮、推进，最终还能
进行火箭冲刺。

可升级将你的BUG
变成一枚高速飞弹，造成
眩晕和/或物理伤害。

entries.source: Flight provides thrust and rocket dynamics. A well-wormed rocket increases speed and range. Drinks a moderate amount of juice.
entries.translation: 飞行提供推进与火箭动力学效果。 经过充分蠕虫强化的火箭冲刺能提升速度与射程。 消耗适量的动力液。

entries.source: Stun hostiles by rocketing into them. Longer run-ups work best.
entries.translation: 用火箭冲刺撞向敌对目标将其击晕。 助跑距离越长，效果越好。

entries.source: Fire yourself like a Bullet! Try it against hostiles and obstacles. Longer run-ups work best.
entries.translation: 把自己像子弹一样射出去！ 用来对付敌对目标和障碍物试试。 助跑距离越长，效果越好。

entries.source: Fly around freely, no height restriction

entries.translation: 火箭冲刺速度更快、距离更远
火箭冲刺速度进一步加快、距离进一步增加
火箭冲刺已增压至最大！

entries.source: Rocket into hostiles to stun them
entries.translation: 用火箭冲刺撞击敌对目标使其眩晕

entries.source: Rocket into hostiles to damage them
entries.translation: 用火箭冲刺撞击敌对目标并造成伤害

entries.source:
On-demand deserialization.

Download your bug to any
in-range line-of-sight 
position.

Upgrade to enable printing
of new instances of
other bits and bots.

<color=green>Can be used as a torch!</color>
entries.translation:
按需反序列化。

将你的BUG下载至下载距离内、
视线可及的任意位置。

升级以解锁打印其他零部件
与机器人的新实体。

<color=green>还可用作手电筒！</color>

entries.source: Worm Range to extend download distance. Drinks a fixed amount of juice per download type, irrespective of distance.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级范围以延长下载距离。 每种下载类型消耗固定量的动力液， 与距离无关。

entries.source: Worm Battery to enable the downloading of Batteries.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级电池以解锁电池下载。

entries.source: Worm Juice to enable the downloading of fresh Juice.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级动力液以解锁新鲜动力液下载。

entries.source: Worm Bio-Crate to enable the downloading of Bio-Containers. Create barriers and cover on the fly.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级生物箱以解锁生物容器下载。 随时随地创建障碍与掩体。

entries.source: Worm Canister to enable the downloading of Ether-Canisters.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级以太罐以解锁以太罐下载。

entries.source: Worm Bug Trap to enable the downloading of Bug-Traps.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级BUG陷阱以解锁BUG陷阱下载。

entries.source: Worm Pup to enable the downloading of Pups.
Worm Dad to enable the downloading of DADs. Downloaded DADs are friendly and ready to ctrl.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级DAD以解锁DAD下载。 下载出的DAD态度友好，随时听候Ctrl。

entries.source: Worm Mum to enable the downloading of MUMs. Downloaded MUMs are friendly and ready to ctrl.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级MUM以解锁MUM下载。 下载出的MUM态度友好，随时听候Ctrl。

entries.source: Worm ??? to enable the downloading of ???. Progress the story to unlock this branch.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级???以解锁???下载。 推进剧情以解锁此分支。
打印距离上限达 [?] 米

entries.source: Enable downloading of packets of juice

Telescopic drill attachment
whose primary function is 
to break bad bots into 
broken bits.

Makes an awful lot of noise.
entries.translation:
伸缩钻头配件，
其主要功能是将坏机器人
打成破烂碎片。

会发出极其巨大的噪音。

entries.source: A well-wormed Drill breaks things apart faster. Fairly thirsty juice consumption.
entries.translation: 充分注入蠕虫的钻头能更快地把东西拆解。 动力液消耗相当大。

entries.source: Worm Extension to drill from farther away.
entries.translation: 用蠕虫升级延长，从更远的地方进行钻探。

entries.source: Increase max drill length to [?] metres
entries.translation: 将钻头最大长度提升至 [?] 米
无法从此处连接吸取器
ⓘ 自我吸取器动力液耗尽

entries.source: ⓘ Ego Sucker no ego to leech
entries.translation: ⓘ 自我吸取器无自我可吸取

entries.source:
Leech ego from unfriendly
hosts.

Ideal for ctrl freaks
and ego-maniacs.
entries.translation:
从敌对宿主身上汲取自我。

控制狂与自大狂的
理想之选。

entries.source: Worm Rate to leech faster. Faster leeching also means less juice consumed per ego fragment gained.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级速率以加快汲取速度。 更快的汲取速度也意味着每获得一个自我碎片 消耗的动力液更少。

entries.source: Worm Bother to cause less bother while leeching. Stagger deployments to avoid causing too much bother.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级警觉，让汲取更不易引起警觉。 错开部署时机，避免引起过高警觉。

entries.source: Worm Reach to leech ego from farther away, allowing you to remain at a safe operable distance.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级范围以从更远处汲取自我， 让你保持在安全的操作距离内。

entries.source: Worm Matter to leech through see-through matter, e.g. glass. Worm deeper to resist through solid matter.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级介质，以穿透 透明物体（如玻璃）进行汲取。 继续升级，可让汲取连接 遇到固体阻隔时继续维持。
汲取自我速度提升 [?] 倍
汲取自我引起的警觉减少！
引起目标警觉前可吸取[?]倍自我

entries.source: Leech ego from a distance of [?]m
entries.translation: 最远可在 [?] 米处吸取自我
可以透过透明物体开始吸取
已启用穿透透明物吸取

entries.source: Ego-sucker resists contact with solid matter for a few seconds
entries.translation: 自我吸取器的汲取连接遇到固体阻隔后可维持数秒
已启用穿透实体吸取（短暂）

entries.source: Ego-sucker resists through solid matter indefinitely
entries.translation: 自我吸取器的汲取连接可在固体阻隔下无限期维持
穿透实体物质吸取（永久）已启用

entries.source:
Introduce faults to turn things
into ethermatically unstable 
'bombs', liable to implode
unless handled with care.

• Heavier objects make 
  more damaging implosions.
• Hostile egos are faultable
  at additional juice cost.
entries.translation:
植入故障，将物体转变为以太
不稳定的“炸弹”，若不小心
对待极易发生内爆。

• 物体越重，内爆造成的
  伤害越大。
• 敌对自我亦可植入故障，
  但需消耗更多动力液。

entries.source: Worm Severity to increase fault implosion damage.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级严重程度，以提升故障内爆伤害。

entries.source: Introduce faults on canisters to enable a kind of catalyst effect, causing more damaging implosions.
entries.translation: 在罐体上植入故障， 可引发某种催化效应， 造成更具毁灭性的内爆。

entries.source:
Induce faults to spread like an infection.
Larger objects spread more widely.
REM: Your host is immune while ctrl'd.
entries.translation:
促使故障像传染病一样蔓延。
体积越大的物体扩散范围越广。
注意：被Ctrl控制时，你的宿主对此免疫。

entries.source: Faulting canisters are extra volatile, causing 1.5x damage on implode
entries.translation: 故障储气罐格外不稳定，内爆时造成 1.5x 伤害

entries.source: Faulting canisters cause [?]x damage when they implode
entries.translation: 故障储气罐内爆时造成 [?]x 伤害

entries.source: Faulting canisters cause [?]x damage when they implode
entries.translation: 故障储气罐内爆时造成 [?]x 伤害

entries.source: New faults will spread to nearby objects
entries.translation: 新故障将扩散至附近的物体

entries.source: Hostiles have a chance to become infected (Larger ego => lower chance)
entries.translation: 敌对目标有几率受到感染（自我越大 => 几率越低）
新故障*可能*扩散至敌对目标

entries.source: Hostiles no longer have any resistance to infection
entries.translation: 敌对目标不再对感染具有抗性

entries.source: New faults will spread to hostiles
entries.translation: 新故障将扩散至敌对目标

entries.source:
Emulates the projection of
an implosive software glitch,
ripping a veritable hole in
the fabric of the simulation,
and causing not insignificant
energy loss to ethermatic
objects caught by the blast.

It's a grenade.
entries.translation:
模拟投射出一个内爆式
软件故障，在模拟机制的
结构上硬生生撕开一个窟窿，
并对爆炸波及的以太物质
物体造成相当可观的能量损失。

其实就是颗手雷。

entries.source: Worm Density for more damaging glitches. Damage is inflicted in proportion to distance from epicentre. Drinks a fixed quota of juice per glitch.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级密度以造成伤害更高的故障。 伤害根据距离爆心的远近按比例造成。 每次故障消耗固定配额的动力液。

entries.source: Worm Volume for larger glitches. Catch more targets and because objects are relatively closer to the glitch epicentre, they'll hurt more.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级范围以扩大故障范围。 波及更多目标，且由于物体相对 更靠近故障爆心，所受伤害也会更高。

entries.source:
Enables grenade aim assistance in your HUD.
Hold secondary fire button to aim.
entries.translation:
在HUD中启用手雷瞄准辅助。
按住次要开火键进行瞄准。
故障手雷爆炸范围增大
基础爆炸范围的 [?] 倍
已启用故障手雷瞄准辅助

entries.source:
Absorbs a proportion of
all incoming damage.

Replenishes your Bug's energy.

Waltz unharmed through deadly
Bug-Traps.

Siphon energy from nearby 
ethermatic targets.
entries.translation:
吸收一定比例的
所有承受伤害。

补充你的BUG能量。

安然无恙地穿过致命的
BUG陷阱。

从附近的以太
目标身上虹吸能量。
升级充能器以更快补充能量。

entries.source: Upgrade Shield to absorb more incoming damage.
entries.translation: 升级护盾以吸收更多承受伤害。
升级虹吸以更快窃取能量。

entries.source:
Etherkinematic coil that can 
shift heavy objects, at range,
to wherever you aim.

Operable through glass and other
see-through barriers.

It's telekinesis for physicists.
entries.translation:
以太动力线圈，可远程将
重物移动到你所瞄准的
任何位置。

可穿透玻璃和其他
透明障碍物进行操作。

这就是物理学家的隔空移物。

entries.source: Worm HeavyMetal to enable shifting of larger, very heavy objects.
entries.translation: 用蠕虫升级重金属， 即可移位更大、极沉重的物体。

entries.source: Worm Strength for a more powerful shift with a longer reach.
entries.translation: 用蠕虫升级强度， 获得更强力、距离更远的移位。

entries.source: Administer a short sharp Shock to hostiles, causing them to malfunction for a wormable duration. The larger their ego, the greater the juice cost.
entries.translation: 对敌对目标施加一次短促强烈的电击， 使其发生故障，持续时间可通过蠕虫延长。 目标的自我越大，消耗的动力液就越多。

entries.source: Shift multiple objects with the Vortex. Aim near but not at ethermatic objects to engage. It's bound to be useful for something.
entries.translation: 使用涡流移位多个物体。 瞄准以太物体附近（但不要正对）即可启动。 总会有用得着它的地方。

entries.source: Enable shift big fat crates and larger loads
entries.translation: 允许移位笨重的大箱子以及更大负荷的物体
更强力的移位；射程 [?] 米

entries.source: Administer a short sharp shock to a targeted hostile
entries.translation: 对目标敌对单位施加短暂而强烈的电击

entries.source: Administer a more powerful, longer-lasting jolt
entries.translation: 施加威力更强、持续时间更长的电击

entries.source: An even more powerful, longer-lasting jolt
entries.translation: 施加威力甚至更强、持续时间更长的电击
施加威力最强、持续时间最长的电击

entries.source: Shift multiple objects in a raging whirlwind
entries.translation: 在狂暴的旋风中移位多个物体

entries.source: Worm 'Big Shot' to enable secondary fire option
entries.translation: 用蠕虫升级“大弹头”以启用次要射击选项

entries.source:
You want a gun?

Fires solid juice.

Get up close and personal
for larger damage.

Brainshots do critical damage.
entries.translation:
想要一把枪？

发射固态动力液。

靠近目标射击，
伤害更足。

爆脑射击造成暴击伤害。

entries.source:
Fire down both barrels!
Deals double damage,
while drinking only 1.5x juice.
entries.translation:
双管齐发！
造成双倍伤害，
却仅消耗1.5倍动力液。

entries.source:
Worm to reduce the 'spread effect' of projecting
solid juice through space at high velocity.
Makes it easier to inflict full damage.
entries.translation:
用蠕虫升级以减少固态动力液
在空间中高速喷射时的“扩散效应”。
更易造成全额伤害。

entries.source:
Steady your aim, reduce kickback.
Rattle off a quick succession of shots
with less recoil and reduced loss of accuracy.
entries.translation:
稳定瞄准，减轻反冲。
快速连射，
后坐力更小，准度损失更低。

entries.source:
Aim for the brain.
Already aiming for the brain?
Worm this and aim for the brain again.
entries.translation:
瞄准大脑打。
已经瞄准大脑了？
用蠕虫升级这个，再往大脑上打。

entries.source: Brain shot criticals inflict [?]x regular damage
entries.translation: 爆脑暴击造成 [?] 倍常规伤害

entries.source: Brain shot criticals inflict [?]x regular damage, up from [??]x
entries.translation: 爆脑暴击造成 [?] 倍常规伤害，高于原先的 [??] 倍

entries.source:
Suck up small bits to recycle
their energy and juice.

Aim the VaQ at lightweight stuff 
to suck it towards you.

Aim at anything else to suck
yourself towards it.
entries.translation:
吸入细小碎片以回收
其能量与动力液。

将VaQ对准轻量物品
可将其吸向你。

对准其他任何物体
则会将你自己吸过去。

entries.source: Worm the VaQ to enable continuous suction mode
entries.translation: 对VaQ使用蠕虫以启用持续吸力模式

entries.source: Worm Extract to convert more energy from every broken bit sucked up
entries.translation: 对萃取使用蠕虫，从吸入的 每块破损碎片中转化出更多能量

entries.source: Worm Juicer to squeeze more juice from every broken bit sucked up
entries.translation: 对榨汁器使用蠕虫，从吸入的 每块破损碎片中榨出更多动力液

entries.source: Worm Fragmenter to spill more ego fragments when breaking hostiles
entries.translation: 对碎解器使用蠕虫，在击碎 敌对目标时掉落更多自我碎片

entries.source: Suck up all nearby bits in one continuous action
entries.translation: 一次持续动作吸起周围所有碎片
消化的破损碎片产出 [?]x 能量
消化的残骸碎片可产出 [?] 倍动力液

entries.source: Salvage [?]% more ego fragments when breaking hostiles apart
entries.translation: 击碎敌对目标时回收的自我碎片增加 [?]%

entries.source:
ⓘ Avoid interacting to remain virtual
ⓘ Worm disk to change this
entries.translation:
ⓘ 避免互动以保持虚体状态
ⓘ 植入蠕虫升级磁盘，可更改此项

entries.source: ⓘ Worm disk to enable virtual multitasking
entries.translation: ⓘ 植入蠕虫升级磁盘，可启用虚体多任务

entries.source:
<color=red>Not possible while under attack!</color>
ⓘ Worm disk Features > Abstract to change this!
entries.translation:
<color=red>受攻击时无法使用！</color>
ⓘ 植入蠕虫升级磁盘的 功能 > 抽象 分支，可更改此项！

entries.source:
ⓘ Avoid using programs to remain virtual
ⓘ Worm disk to enable multitasking
entries.translation:
ⓘ 避免使用程序以保持虚体状态
ⓘ 植入蠕虫升级磁盘，可启用多任务处理

entries.source:
ⓘ Avoid grabbing stuff to remain virtual
ⓘ Worm disk to enable multitasking
entries.translation:
ⓘ 避免抓取物品以保持虚体状态
ⓘ 植入蠕虫升级磁盘，可启用多任务处理

entries.source:
Harness the second law of 
ethermatics to get around 
unseen.

Interaction with the simulation
is initially constrained but can
be enhanced by upgrading.
entries.translation:
利用以太学第二定律
神不知鬼不觉地四处穿行。

起初与模拟世界的互动
会受到限制，但可通过
升级来增强。

entries.source: User movement speed is limited to a Creep. Worm to increase the virtual speed cap. Juice is consumed to preserve virtual integrity.
entries.translation: 使用者移动速度被限制为潜行。 植入蠕虫升级以提高虚拟速度上限。 消耗动力液以维持虚拟完整性。

entries.source: Worm Concurrency to remain virtual while doing stuff e.g. interacting, carrying. Worm deeper to enable concurrent program usage.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级并发，以便在执行各种操作（例如交互、搬运）时 保持虚拟状态。 继续植入蠕虫升级可启用程序的并发使用。

entries.source: Worm Trip to pass undetected through tripwires while virtual.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级绊线穿越，以便在虚拟状态下 不被察觉地穿过绊线。

entries.source: Worm Idle to remain virtual at zero juice cost while idling. i.e. not moving, not interacting, not using other programs.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级闲置，以便在闲置时 以零动力液消耗保持虚拟状态。 即：不移动、不交互、不使用其他程序。

entries.source: Worm Abstract to be able to go virtual even when under attack and/or receiving damage.
entries.translation: 植入蠕虫升级抽象，以便即使在遭受攻击 和/或受到伤害时也能进入虚拟状态。

entries.source: Remain virtual while interacting and carrying
entries.translation: 在互动和搬运时保持虚拟状态

entries.source: Remain virtual while using other programs, at 50% juice penalty
entries.translation: 在使用其他程序时保持虚拟状态，但有50%的额外动力液消耗

entries.source: Remain virtual while using other programs, at 25% juice penalty
entries.translation: 在使用其他程序时保持虚拟状态，但有25%的额外动力液消耗

entries.source: Remain virtual while using other programs, with no juice penalty
entries.translation: 在使用其他程序时保持虚拟状态，且无额外动力液消耗

entries.source: Tripwires don't trip if you pass through them while virtual
entries.translation: 在虚拟状态下穿过绊线不会触发报警

entries.source: Tripwires no longer trip while virtual
entries.translation: 虚拟状态下不再触发绊线

entries.source: Drink zero juice while virtual and idle
entries.translation: 在虚拟且闲置状态下消耗零动力液

entries.source: Go virtual during combat or when receiving damage
entries.translation: 在战斗中或受到伤害时进入虚拟状态

entries.source:
I've managed to slip a couple of bugs into
the Bug Free Zone, but the freight lift
to reach the GOD Dock is offline.

Dr Everyman reckons I need to terminate the
remote debug session before I can proceed.
entries.translation:
我成功把两只BUG弄进了
无BUG区，但前往GOD停靠站的
货运升降机已离线。

埃弗里曼博士认为我需要先终止
远程调试会话，然后才能继续。

entries.source:
The direct route back to the Bug Free Zone
was sealed, so I've ducked into an
integrated cooling duct to try to find an
alternative way round.
entries.translation:
直接返回无BUG区的路线
已被封闭，所以我钻进了一条
集成冷却管道，试图找到一条
替代路线绕过去。

entries.source:
I assembled a new bug
and then through absolutely no fault
of my own... disassembled it.

I need to find an alternative
way to bypass the vexatious
dual bug-lock door.
entries.translation:
我组装了一只新BUG，
然后，在绝对不是我的错的情况下……
我又把它拆解了。

我得找个替代方法
来绕过那扇恼人的
双重BUG锁大门。

entries.source:
I've assembled a new bug and 
should now be able to access
the Merging Station.
entries.translation:
我组装了一只新BUG，
现在应该可以进入
合并站了。

entries.source:
The route back to the Bug Free Zone was
blocked by a double-bug-lock door.
 
But I don't care because I found 
another way through.

I ought to be commended for my cleverness.
entries.translation:
返回无BUG区的路线被一扇
双重BUG锁大门挡住了。
 
但我不在乎，因为我找到了
另一条穿过去的路。

我的机智理应受到表扬。

entries.source:
I've made it through to something called
'The Merging Station', which I'm hoping 
leads back to the Bug Free Zone.
entries.translation:
我成功穿过通道，来到了一个叫作
“合并站”的地方，希望它能
通回无BUG区。

entries.source:
The route back to the Bug Free Zone is
blocked by a door with a dual bug-lock,
and I've only got one bug.
entries.translation:
返回无BUG区的路线被一扇
带有双重BUG锁的大门挡住了，
而我只有一只BUG。

entries.source:
I managed to stop the debugger -
Dr Everyman was very complimentary
about my debugging skills.

With the debugger out of action,
the Bug Free Zone should now be out of 
lockdown, and no more than a return
ego-net trip away.
entries.translation:
我成功关停了调试器——
埃弗里曼博士对我的
调试技巧赞不绝口。

随着调试器停止运作，
无BUG区现在应该已解除封锁，
只需通过自我网络折返即可到达。

entries.source: I appear to be some kind of bodiless ego. Someone calling himself Dr Everyman is ctrl-ing the CATs and speaking to me through them. Dr Everyman wants me to exploit bugs in order to deal with a "parasite".
entries.translation: 我似乎成了某种没有肉身的自我。 一个自称埃弗里曼博士的人 正Ctrl着CAT，并通过它们 同我说话。 埃弗里曼博士想让我利用BUG 来解决一个“寄生虫”。

entries.source:
Having endured a not insignificant 
system detour, I'm at last on my way 
back to the GOD Dock...

...where the Parasite awaits.
entries.translation:
在系统中绕了一大段
远路后，我终于踏上了
返回GOD停靠站的路……

……寄生虫正在那里恭候。

entries.source:
So... back to the Bug Free Zone then,
which should be out of lockdown by now.

I'm getting used to this disembodied
malarkey, even if I still don't
fully understand it.
entries.translation:
那么……这就回无BUG区吧，
那儿现在应该已经解除封锁了。

我逐渐习惯这种脱离肉身的
鬼把戏了，哪怕我至今还没
完全搞明白它究竟是怎么回事。

entries.source:
Dr Everyman wants me to exploit bugs 
and grow my ego in order to deal with
the parasite.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士想让我利用BUG
并壮大我的自我，
以便对付寄生虫。

entries.source:
Something went a bit wrong when I
attempted to breach the Bug Free Zone
and I've lost ctrl of my bug.

But Dr Everyman seems convinced 
there's something at the launch site
that can help me get it back.
entries.translation:
当我试图突破无BUG区时
出了点岔子，
我失去了对我BUG的Ctrl。

但埃弗里曼博士似乎深信，
发射场有什么东西
能帮我把它找回来。

entries.source:
I've come to The Cloud to look
for the last backup version
of Dr Everyman.
entries.translation:
我来到云端，
寻找埃弗里曼博士的
最后一份备份。

entries.source:
I found the bootleg copy of DEV.exe,
installed it into my bug,
and now Dr Everyman is inside my mind.

Dr Everyman believes if we can find GOD
then it still might be possible to save
human consciousness.
entries.translation:
我找到了DEV.exe的盗版副本，
将它安装进了我的BUG中，
现在埃弗里曼博士已经在我的脑海里了。

埃弗里曼博士认为，只要能找到GOD，
就依然有可能拯救
人类意识。

entries.source:
I'm about to save human consciousness
by feeding my ego
into the Consciousness Ctrl Stream.
entries.translation:
我正准备将我的自我
喂入意识Ctrl流中，
以拯救人类意识。

entries.source:
Dr Everyman reckons we can take over a GOD
by feeding bugs into the 
Consciousness Ctrl Stream.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士估计，我们可以通过将BUG
喂入意识Ctrl流中
来接管一台GOD。

entries.source:
The last backup version of Dr Everyman
might be located on a disk labelled 'DEV'
in the Heavenly Cloud Storage extension.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士的最后一份备份
可能存放在天堂云存储扩展区里
一张贴着“DEV”标签的磁盘上。

entries.source:
I've made it through to The Merging Station,
which I'm hoping leads back to the
Bug Free Zone.
entries.translation:
我成功穿行到了合并站，
希望这里能通往
无BUG区。

entries.source:
Did Dr Everyman say I was 'source code'?

A 'branch of development'?

Whatever. I'm to merge myself back 
into the Bug Free Zone by establishing a
secure connection from the merging station.
entries.translation:
埃弗里曼博士刚才说我是“源代码”？

还是一个“开发分支”？

管他呢。我得从合并站
建立一条安全连接，
将我自己合并回无BUG区。

entries.source:
I stopped the debugger and the Bug Free
Zone should now be out of lockdown.

But hang on - this doesn't look like the 
Bug Free Zone at all - where am I?
entries.translation:
我停止了调试器，
无BUG区现在应该解除封锁了。

等等——这里看着根本不像
无BUG区——我这是在哪儿？

entries.source:
Something went wrong during my ego trip
back to the Bug Free Zone - Dr Everyman 
redirected me to the relative safety of 
a place crammed with retro hardware.

I need to make my way back to the 
Bug Free Zone the old fashioned way.
entries.translation:
在我自我神游回
无BUG区时出了点岔子——埃弗里曼博士
把我重定向到了一个塞满复古硬件的
相对安全的地方。

我得用老办法
摸回无BUG区了。

entries.source:
I'm making my way through Legacy Systems
to try to get back to the Bug Free Zone.

MUM shall not deter me.
entries.translation:
我正穿过遗留系统，
试图返回无BUG区。

MUM阻止不了我。

entries.source:
I've made it to the Legacy Front-End
from where I'm hoping to find a 
connection back to the Bug Free Zone.
entries.translation:
我已经来到了遗留前端，
希望能从这里找到
返回无BUG区的连接。

entries.source:
The parasite is no more.
But where did it come from?
And why was it here?

Dr Everyman seems to think his old company,
the tech giant Conscious Robot Services (CRS)
might have something to do with it.
entries.translation:
寄生虫不复存在了。
但它是从哪儿来的？
又为什么会在这里？

埃弗里曼博士似乎觉得，他的老东家——
科技巨头“有意识机器人服务公司”（CRS）
可能脱不了干系。

entries.source:
I defeated the parasite!

But where did it come from?

Why was it here?
entries.translation:
我打败了寄生虫！

但它是从哪儿来的？

又为什么会在这里？

entries.source:
This is it.

The parasite.

Its time has come.
entries.translation:
就是现在了。

那个寄生虫。

它的死期到了。

entries.source: A dangerous parasite is out of ctrl in the vicinity of the GOD dock, subverting the consciousness ctrl stream and taking ctrl of everything. I appear to be some kind of bodiless entity - an ego, the CAT said.
entries.translation: 一只危险的寄生虫 在GOD码头附近失控了， 它颠覆了意识Ctrl流， 正在夺取一切的Ctrl权。 我似乎是某种没有肉身的实体—— CAT说，那是一个自我。

entries.source:
I'm such a clever ego I decided to skip
finding a new bug.

I'm heading back to the Bug Free Zone,
bug or no bug.
entries.translation:
我可真是个聪明的自我，决定跳过
寻找新BUG这一步。

我正赶回无BUG区，
管它有没有BUG。

entries.source:
I found a bug with an arm and a working
disk drive and it seems the bug can be 
upgraded by feeding it disks and worms.

Ultimately I need to make my way back
to the Bug Free Zone, but there may be
goodies to find around the rocket ctrl
site first.
entries.translation:
我找到了一个带有机械臂和可用
磁盘驱动器的BUG，看起来这个BUG
可以通过喂它磁盘和蠕虫来升级。

最终我需要想办法回到
无BUG区，不过在发射控制室
附近也许能先找到点好东西。

entries.source:
I've found an upgradeable bug and installed
a disk that enables me to rocket around.

Dr Everyman seems to think I'm ready 
to try the Bug Free Zone again.

I just need to get back there.
entries.translation:
我找到了一个可升级的BUG，并安装了
一个能让我使用火箭冲刺的磁盘。

埃弗里曼博士似乎认为我已经准备好
再次挑战无BUG区了。

我只需要回到那里就行。

entries.source:
I've remoted in to the debugging facility.

According to Dr Everyman, 
stopping the debugger will grant me
full access to the Bug Free Zone.
entries.translation:
我已经远程连接到了调试设施。

根据埃弗里曼博士的说法，
停掉调试器就能让我
完全进入无BUG区。

entries.source:
I found a way to reach the 
launch ctrl facility.

I should look around, I suppose.
entries.translation:
我找到了前往
发射控制室的路。

我想我该到处转转看。

entries.source:
If I'm to make it through the Bug Free Zone
I'll likely need more
than an ill-equipped bug.

Dr Everyman reckons I can upgrade a new bug
here at the launch facility.
entries.translation:
要想闯过无BUG区，
光靠一个装备简陋的BUG
恐怕是不够的。

埃弗里曼博士觉得我可以在发射设施这里
升级一个新的BUG。

entries.source:
The parasite awaits me at the other end
of the Freight Workshop and Transit Hub.

This could be my last opportunity 
to prepare for it.
entries.translation:
那只寄生虫正在货运车间与转运枢纽的
另一端等着我。

这可能是我为对付它
做准备的最后机会了。

序幕
从前有个自我

第 4 章
碎片整理

第 5 章
合并请求

第 7 章
有意识机器人

entries.source:
<size=30>Chapter 7:
Conscious Robots</size>

Something strange is going on at
Conscious Robot services
entries.translation:
<size=30>第 7 章：
有意识机器人</size>

有意识机器人服务公司
似乎有些不对劲

第8章
埃弗里曼的自我

entries.source:
I'm to investigate Conscious Robot Services
for a possible connection to the parasite.

Given Dr Everyman used to work at CRS,
perhaps I can learn more about him too.
entries.translation:
我要调查有意识机器人服务公司（CRS），
看看它是否与那寄生虫有关联。

鉴于埃弗里曼博士曾就职于 CRS，
或许我也能对他有更多了解。

entries.source: Dr Everyman was murdered by The Executor.
entries.translation: 埃弗里曼博士被执行者谋杀了。

entries.source: The Executor seems to think he's Dr Everyman?
entries.translation: 执行者似乎认为自己就是埃弗里曼博士？

entries.source: The Executor is a branch of Dr Everyman.
entries.translation: 执行者是埃弗里曼博士的一个分支。

entries.source:
I came into being when The Executor
attempted to restore the Everyman ego.
entries.translation:
当执行者试图恢复埃弗里曼的自我时，
我便诞生了。

entries.source:
The Executor released the parasite,
but Dr Everyman preemptively arranged
for a branch of his ego to return
to deal with it. Me.
entries.translation:
执行者释放了寄生虫，
但埃弗里曼博士预先安排了
让自身自我的一个分支返回
来处理这件事。也就是我。

entries.source:
Dear BigRiver,

I ordered an *EMU*
That's E M U
all uppercase
Ego Mode Utility
Not "emu"
all lowercase
pointless desk ornament
entries.translation:
尊敬的大河：

我订购的是*EMU*
是 E M U
全大写字母
自我模式实用程序
而不是“emu”
全小写字母
毫无用处的鸸鹋桌面摆件

entries.source: (Aborting continues the story - it's fine to abort!)
entries.translation: （中止会推进剧情——中止完全没问题！）

entries.source:
this is a safe spot
i think

if i were you
i'd think "puzzle"
rather than "boss fight"
entries.translation:
这里很安全
我想

如果我是你
我更愿意把它当成“解谜”
而不是“Boss战”

entries.source:
EGO: all that remains of you
CAT: Ctrl Alt Terminal
EYE: look around (<color=white>MOUSE</color> or <color=white>RS</color>)
entries.translation:
自我：你所剩下的一切
CAT：Ctrl Alt 终端
眼：环顾四周（<color=white>鼠标</color>或<color=white>RS</color>）

entries.source:
oh
you're here
that is
er
surprising
considering all the changes
i made to you
entries.translation:
哦
你来了
这可
呃
真令人惊讶
考虑到我对你做的
那些改动

entries.source:
why am i typing?
loading SAY...
ok better
entries.translation:
我为什么在打字？
正在加载 SAY……
好多了

entries.source:
EMU = Ego Mode Utility
GOD = ???

Ctrl the EMU in GOD
entries.translation:
EMU = 自我模式效用工具 (Ego Mode Utility)
GOD = ???

Ctrl GOD 里的 EMU

entries.source:
pups
friendly
helpful
safe

DADs
not friendly
but can still be helpful
there's one holed up in the floor here

find a way to get DAD
to reveal himself
ctrl him
use his fatherly powers
to get pup over the barricade
entries.translation:
PUP
友好
有用
安全

DAD
不友好
但依然有用
这里地板下就藏着一个

想办法让 DAD
现身
ctrl 他
利用他作为父亲的力量
让 PUP 越过路障

entries.source:
TAB - Task Activity Broker
i'll post important info to your TAB

the parasite
is taking ctrl of everything

we need to ctrl *it*

use ego mode to exit GOD
entries.translation:
TAB - 任务活动代理 (Task Activity Broker)
我会把重要信息发到你的 TAB 上

寄生体
正在 ctrl 一切

我们需要 ctrl *它*

使用自我模式退出 GOD

埃弗里曼博士
随时为自己效劳

entries.source:
the parasite awaits you
again

here's hoping we finally built a version
where you win

check stash first?
entries.translation:
寄生体在等着你
又一次

但愿我们这次终于造出了
能让你赢的版本

先检查一下储藏点？

entries.source:
☑ well done

<color=red>PERMISSION DENIED</color>
<color=red>CONTENT REDACTED</color>
<color=red>ILLEGAL BROADCAST</color>
<color=red>DISCONNECT IMMEDIATELY</color>

<color=red>SEVERELY</color>

they think i made the parasite
but i'm innocent
completely innocent

Conscious Robot Services
C R S

find the ego-net gateway
get to the CRS research facility
entries.translation:
☑ 干得漂亮

<color=red>权限不足</color>
<color=red>内容已涂黑遮蔽</color>
<color=red>非法广播</color>
<color=red>请立即断开连接</color>
<color=red>同谋与协从人员</color>

他们以为是我造出了寄生体
但我很无辜
彻彻底底无辜

有意识机器人服务公司
C R S

找到自我网络网关
前往 CRS 研究设施

entries.source:
bug?

the plan:
exploit bug

remember to keep an eye on your TAB
entries.translation:
bug？

计划：

entries.source: Notes from the code face #053: A debugger or debugging tool is a computer program used to identify, analyse and diagnose the underlying causes of software faults, or bugs. When a debugger found itself cameoing in the original version of the popular video game Ctrl Alt Ego (circa 2022), little did the developers know that their narrative would one day herald the invention of the Bug Free Zones we know and love today.
entries.translation: 代码前线笔记 #053： 调试器（debugger）或调试工具是一种计算机程序，用于识别、分析和诊断软件故障（即 BUG）的根本原因。 当调试器在热门电子游戏《Ctrl Alt Ego》（约2022年）的原版中客串出场时，开发者们未曾想到，他们的故事情节有朝一日竟然预告了我们如今熟知且喜爱的无 BUG 区的发明。

      Please do not use the bug reporting system to ask

      There is no right answer - it's up to you.

      DO NOT FIX.

Bug report #005

  • Summary: 
      DADs can't see through crates
        
  • Steps to reproduce: 
      1. Wait behind a crate until DAD looks towards me
      2. I can see DAD, but DAD can't see me
        
  • CRS developer comment:
      This is because DAD 'sees' using ethermatic pulses -
      he doesn't have a conventional EYE module.
      DAD's virtual serialization queue only requires
      ethermatic sighting, an additional EYE would
      increase production costs for negligible benefit.
      
  • Action:
      DO NOT FIX.

  • 摘要：

      2. 我能看见DAD，但DAD看不见我
        
  • CRS开发者回复：
      这是因为DAD使用以太脉冲来“看”——
      他没有常规的EYE模块。
      DAD的虚拟序列化队列只需要以太瞄准，
      额外加装EYE只会增加生产成本，收益却微乎其微。
      
  • 处理措施：
      无需修复。

      2. The crate moves
        
  • CRS developer comment:
      Because of the not insignificant logistical 
      advantages, CRS produced ethermatic crates
      are intentionally designed to be serializable.
      A side-effect of the manufacturing process is
      that real mass no longer correlates 100% with
      virtual mass.
      
  • Action:
      DO NOT FIX.

      该制造工艺的一个副作用是：
      真实质量与虚拟质量不再100%关联。

      无需修复。

Dear cruel world,

I'm leaving this note in case I don't make it out of here, which is looking increasingly likely.

We were told to evacuate NOW, but - stupidly, I realise with hindsight - I wanted to grab my files first.

I think I'm trapped here.

MUM has gone nuts.

Mustn't let her see me.

I tried breaking her apart, but all that happened was another MUM appeared.

Conclusion: waste of juice.

I need to ctrl her, it's my only chance.

Love you Mum. 

Chris.

PS. Not "love you MUM", "love you, Mum" - my real Mum, I mean.

我留下这张便条，以防我出不去——现在看来这可能性越来越大了。

我们被通知“立即”撤离，但——事后我才意识到自己真蠢——我想先把我的文件拿到手。

我觉得我被困在这里了。

千万不能让她看见我。

我必须ctrl她，这是我唯一的机会。

爱你，妈妈。

克里斯。

又及：不是“爱你，MUM”，是“爱你，妈妈”——我是指我亲妈。

Oh well, at least they made me invulnerable.

If I'm to be DAD, I suppose I should at least try to enjoy it and try to bag me some bugs.

Frank.

entries.source:
It's all gone pear shaped and I don't know what to do.

I've been told my mind and all my ego dump backups are now the property of the thing everyone is calling 'the parasite'.

Can that really be true? Is my mind and all its history now owned by something that isn't me? How can that have been allowed to happen?

I don't know whether to stay holed up here and hope this nightmare ends soon, or else go face... well, whatever fate awaits me.

Simon says that most likely my body will be ordered to undergo matter cessation, and that my ego will be redeployed as a MUM - to serve the parasite as one of its enforcement agents.

I'm so scared.

And what's happened to Lucia?

If anyone sees this, please, I beg you, help us. Help us all.

Sadia.
entries.translation:
一切都搞砸了，我不知道该怎么办。

有人告诉我，我的心智和我所有的自我转储备份，现在都成了那个被大家称作“寄生体”的东西的财产。

这真的是真的吗？我的心智以及它所有的经历，现在都归一个不是我的东西所有了？怎么能允许这种事情发生？

我不知道该继续躲在这里寄希望于这场噩梦早点结束，还是出去面对……唉，面对等待着我的无论什么命运。

西蒙说，极大概率我的肉体会接到物质终止指令，而我的自我将被重新部署为MUM——作为执法代理之一去为寄生体效力。

我好害怕。

露西亚又怎么样了？

要是有人看到这个，求求你，救救我们。救救我们大家吧。

萨迪亚。

You'd need a bug with aeronautics though, and they've been banned, so, yeh, wotevs.

不过你得需要一只带航空组件的BUG才行，而那些早就被禁了，所以嘛，害，无所谓啦。

去喝杯果汁？

萨迪亚。

Got them!

Can't believe I must have gone past it on my way into the subway dozens of times without noticing.

Out of interest, where does the second iris lead?

L.

L.

entries.source: In the news this hour... The Bug Free Zone might no longer be bug free! Footage posted to various social media platforms reveals that up to two (2) whole bugs may potentially have been running wild inside the Bug Free Zone earlier today, before disappearing abruptly in a puff of ethermatic smoke. We'll bring you the footage just as soon as legal have signed it off for broadcast. Stay tuned!
entries.translation: 本小时新闻要点…… 无BUG区可能不再无BUG！ 发布在各大社交媒体平台上的视频显示，今天早些时候，无BUG区内可能有多达整整两（2）只BUG到处乱窜，随后在一阵以太烟雾中突然消失。 一旦法务部门批准播出，我们将立即为您呈现该视频。 请持续关注！

entries.source: In the news this hour... Vicious virus at the GOD dock The virus - or parasite as many are calling it - continues its mind-altering spree in and around the GOD docking facility. The virus is estimated to have subsumed as many as 256 egos since it first commandeered the consciousness ctrl stream, including many if not all the MUM and DAD defence units in that sector. Stay safe!
entries.translation: 本小时新闻要点…… GOD船坞爆发恶性病毒 该病毒——或者正如许多人所称的寄生虫——正在GOD停泊设施及其周围继续其精神控制狂欢。 据估计，自该病毒首次强行接管意识ctrl流以来，已吞噬多达256个自我，其中包括该区域内许多（甚至全部）MUM和DAD防御单位。 注意安全！

entries.source: In the news this hour... CRS under emergency quarantine The central research and development hub of the Conscious Robot Services corporation has announced measures to self-isolate, on the back of the recent leak implicating the corporation in the illegal development of a parasite-like ego-bearing organism. CRS deny the allegations, but opted to adopt the extraordinary procedure to avoid the spread of panic, a company spokesperson said. Stay here!
entries.translation: 本小时新闻要点…… CRS进入紧急隔离状态 有意识机器人服务公司（CRS）的中央研发中心已宣布采取自我隔离措施。此前有泄密事件指控该公司非法研发一种类似寄生虫的载有自我的有机体。 公司发言人表示，CRS否认这些指控，但选择采取这一非常规程序以避免恐慌蔓延。 待在原地！

entries.source: In the news this hour... Did someone open a merge request? Observers at the merging station have seen evidence that a Mister D Everyman has raised a merge request "to fix some stuff". In recent weeks, development on the new version has ground almost to a complete halt, with no code changes anticipated at this time. However, observers are optimistic the new merge request will be accepted 'momentarily' and it is hoped that soon thereafter normal output will resume. Keep coding!
entries.translation: 本小时新闻要点…… 有人发起了合并请求吗？ 合并站的观察人员发现有迹象表明，一位D·埃弗里曼先生发起了一项合并请求，“为了修复一些东西”。 最近几周，新版本的开发几乎完全停滞，目前预计不会有任何代码变动。 然而，观察人员乐观地认为，新的合并请求将在“片刻后”被接受，并希望在此之后不久能恢复正常产出。 继续写代码吧！

entries.source: In the news this hour... Fathers for justice! A disgruntled DAD may have been responsible for today's terrorist attack at the merging station. Eye-witness accounts testify that the DAD was seen downloading volatile material prior to the attack. Stay alert!
entries.translation: 本小时新闻要点…… 为了正义的父亲们！ 今天在合并站发生的恐怖袭击可能是一名心怀不满的DAD所为。 目击者证实，在袭击发生前，曾看到该DAD正在下载不稳定的危险物质。 保持警惕！

Summary: Faulting canisters are especially volatile and considerably more implosive. Method: Equip a bug with fault.exe, worm the Canisters disk block, apply fault to ethermaterial canisters. Results: The range and ferocity of faulting canister implosions correlates well with program worm function. Conclusion: Canisters should be kept in a secure environment, well away from fault operators. Issue has been raised with engineering. Future Work: It might be possible to chain canister implosions, though more research is needed in this area.
entries.translation: **************************** ** 实验记录 ** **************************** 实验标题：故障罐体 背景：已知罐体会催化内爆并加剧局部破坏，无论其是否处于故障状态。 概述：处于故障状态的罐体极不稳定，且内爆威力显著增强。 方法：为BUG装配fault.exe，对罐体磁盘块植入蠕虫，对以太材料罐体应用故障程序。 结果：故障罐体内爆的范围与剧烈程度与程序的蠕虫功能高度相关。 结论：罐体应存放于安全环境中，远离故障操作人员。该问题已上报工程部门。 后续工作：或许可以实现连锁罐体内爆，但该领域仍需进一步研究。
