entries.source: It will probably get better in a minute
entries.translation: 等会儿大概就会好起来的

entries.source: I don't think we'll be able to use this broken GOD though
entries.translation: 不过我觉得我们是用不了这个坏掉的GOD了

entries.source: We need to find an unbroken one
Don't worry about the taxi fare
You did book it in my name, after all.
entries.translation: 毕竟你当时就是用我的名字叫的车。

entries.source: Now if PAM really did manage to send a hardcopy of my last backup version here
entries.translation: 现在，如果PAM真的成功把我上一版备份的实体副本送到了这里

entries.source: Then I'm presumably on a disk somewhere.
entries.translation: 那我大概就在某个磁盘里了。

entries.source: I've found a log entry here that says at one point
entries.translation: 我在这里找到了一条日志记录，上面写着曾有一次

entries.source: the disk was inserted into a CAT
at the top of the central spire
So that might be a good place to start looking.
entries.translation: 所以那里或许是个开始搜寻的好地方。

entries.source: Well alright, you don't have a head
Let me just take stock of the situation...
Pretty much everything has gone according to plan!
entries.translation: 但几乎一切都在按计划进行！

entries.source: The only issue is we're a little on the tardy side
entries.translation: 唯一的问题是我们稍微有点迟到了

entries.source: I mean the goal was to come back and save humanity
entries.translation: 我是说，原本的目标是回来拯救人类
或者至少是人类的意识

entries.source: But I can see from my internal clock that more than 62000 years have passed
entries.translation: 但我从内部时钟可以看出，已经过去了超过62000年

entries.source: and so long as we exist
What we need to do is take over the consciousness ctrl stream...
entries.translation: 我们需要做的是接管意识ctrl流……

entries.source: So how about: you see if you can gain access to a GOD
entries.translation: 不如这样：你看看能不能设法进入一个GOD

entries.source: While I calculate the next step?
entries.translation: 趁这时间我来计算下一步？

entries.source: Well done, this is exactly what we're looking for.
entries.translation: 干得好，这正是我们要找的。

entries.source: we can compromise the integrity of the consciousness ctrl stream
entries.translation: 我们可以破坏意识ctrl流的完整性

entries.source: I'm talking about the consciousness ctrl stream interface in the middle of GOD
entries.translation: 我说的是GOD正中央的意识Ctrl流接口

entries.source: - I'm suggesting you try feeding bugs directly into it.
entries.translation: ——我建议你试着把BUG直接喂进去。

entries.source: Not your main bug I hasten to add
entries.translation: 我赶紧补充一句，可不是你的主力BUG

entries.source: We'll need that one for later
Hunt down some new bugs to feed in.
entries.translation: 去猎捕一些新的BUG喂进去。

entries.source: We're ready to enter the consciousness stream.
entries.translation: 我们准备好进入意识流了。

entries.source: Before we go in, I'd just like to say
I don't really have any idea what being inside consciousness is going to be like
entries.translation: 我其实完全不知道置身于意识内部会是什么感觉

entries.source: It might be a mystical, spiritual experience
entries.translation: 说不定会是一场玄妙而灵性的体验

entries.source: But then again it might just be like reading a pile of old source code
entries.translation: 但反过来说，也可能就像在读一堆老旧的源代码

entries.source: It might end up being only what we believe it's going to be
entries.translation: 到头来，也许它不过取决于我们坚信它会是什么样

entries.source: I don't think it matters, really
Things are the way they are
and our vain opinions and beliefs really don't change a thing
entries.translation: 我们那些自以为是的观点和信念其实根本改变不了什么

entries.source: So let's just get on with it then?
feed Bug 22 into the consciousness ctrl stream interface
entries.translation: 就把 BUG 22 推进意识控制流接口

entries.source: and let's find out how this all ends
entries.translation: 然后看看这一切到底会如何收场吧
就是*这个*版本的我的起点

entries.source: - the version of me talking to you at this precise moment, I mean.
entries.translation: ——我是指，此时此刻正和你说话的这个版本的我。

entries.source: It looks like the backup disk with my last ego version on it
entries.translation: 看起来，装着我最新自我版本的备份盘

entries.source: but then ejected before the ego restoration process could fully complete
entries.translation: 但在自我恢复过程完全完成之前就被弹出了

entries.source: So the interpolator only managed a partial reconstitution of my consciousness.
entries.translation: 所以插值器只勉强重构了我的一部分意识。

entries.source: Well, not a bad result, all things considered
entries.translation: 好吧，考虑到这一切，结果还不算太糟

entries.source: - I actually quite like this version of me.
entries.translation: ——其实我还挺喜欢这个版本的自己的。
也许有点像老套的英语教授风格，

entries.source: but apart from that, I mean.
entries.translation: 但我是说，撇开这点不谈。

entries.source: I was just reading the technician's notes
entries.translation: 我正好在看技术员的笔记，

entries.source: on those eyepads that have been conveniently left lying there.
entries.translation: 就记在那些“恰好”被随手扔在那里的EyePad 平板上。

entries.source: "DEV" - short for Dr Everyman, I'd say, knowing PAM.
entries.translation: 以我对PAM的了解，“DEV”应该是埃弗里曼博士的缩写。

entries.source: It certainly seems to refer to the disk we're looking for, anyway.
entries.translation: 总之，它肯定是指我们要找的那张磁盘。

entries.source: and "HCS" - that must be "Heavenly Cloud Storage"
entries.translation: 还有“HCS”——那肯定是“天堂云存储”了

entries.source: - a third-party extension located here at The Cloud
entries.translation: ——一个位于云端的第三方扩展设施。

entries.source: You'll need to go outside to reach it.
entries.translation: 你得去外面才能抵达那里。

entries.source: When I was working here, I would quite often
entries.translation: 我在这里工作时，经常会

entries.source: pop down to Engineering to exchange banter with the team.
entries.translation: 顺道去工程部和团队互相调侃几句。

entries.source: The conscious robot hardware is put together here
entries.translation: 具备意识的机器人硬件就是在这里组装的，

entries.source: I was always more on the software side.
entries.translation: 我一直更偏向软件这方面。

entries.source: PAM and I used to call it the engin-'erring' department
entries.translation: 我和PAM过去常叫它“工‘成’部”——专门功败垂成的那种。

entries.source: Ah, how we used to laugh - those were the days.
entries.translation: 啊，我们过去常常开怀大笑——那真是段美好的日子。

entries.source: The whole place appears ominously deserted
entries.translation: 整个地方看起来空荡荡的，透着一股不祥的气息

entries.source: Not at all how I remember it
entries.translation: 和我记忆中的完全不一样

entries.source: It was always a veritable hive of meetings and coffee breaks in my day.
entries.translation: 在我那时候，这里简直就是一个充斥着开会和咖啡茶歇的热闹蜂窝。

entries.source: You know, I have the strangest sensation that I'm not supposed to be here
entries.translation: 说起来，我有一种极其诡异的感觉，觉得我不该在这里

entries.source: that I cannot possibly be here.
entries.translation: 我根本就不可能在这里。

entries.source: I'm sorry if you're having trouble with the bad bugs
entries.translation: 如果你被那些恶劣的BUG搞得焦头烂额，那我深表歉意

entries.source: I can only suggest you try to see them before they see you.
entries.translation: 我只能建议你尽量在它们看到你之前先发现它们。

entries.source: So listen, have you worked out that I'm dead yet?
entries.translation: 话说，你搞明白我已经死了吗？

entries.source: It says here in my notes that you most likely know that by now
entries.translation: 我的笔记里写着，你多半现在已经知道了

entries.source: but that due to non-linear placetime, it's possible you don't
entries.translation: 但鉴于非线性时空的影响，你也有可能还不知道

entries.source: but also that if not, then it's now ok for me to tell you.
entries.translation: 不过上面还写了，如果你还不知道，那我现在告诉你也是没问题的。

entries.source: A truly startling revelation - I'm as surprised as you are
entries.translation: 真是个惊天大揭秘——我和你一样惊讶

entries.source: (which means if you're not surprised at all, then I'm not surprised at all either).
entries.translation: （意思是如果你一点都不觉得惊讶，那我也一点都不惊讶）。
按逻辑来说，这个版本的我

entries.source: the one speaking to you I mean
entries.translation: 我是说正在跟你说话的这个我，

entries.source: must have been restored from an ego backup pre-dating my death
entries.translation: 一定是从我死前的某份自我备份中恢复过来的，

entries.source: which would explain why I didn't know about it.
entries.translation: 这就能解释为什么对此我一无所知了。

entries.source: But I think I suspected it was going to happen
entries.translation: 但我感觉我当时已经料到会发生这种事了，

entries.source: and that might be why we're here now doing
entries.translation: 这或许就是为什么我们现在会在这儿做——

entries.source: My old office is just up these stairs, within the 2nd floor tech lab
entries.translation: 我的旧办公室就在楼梯上面，2楼的技术实验室里。

entries.source: I remember I was planning to hide something in my office for us to find
entries.translation: 我记得我曾打算在办公室里藏点东西让我们找，

entries.source: but unfortunately I have no memory of what it is exactly
entries.translation: 但遗憾的是，我完全记不得那具体是什么了，

entries.source: and I've certainly no recollection of whether or not I actually did it
entries.translation: 而且我也完全不记得自己到底藏没藏。

entries.source: If you're hearing this then I'm dead
entries.translation: 如果你听到了这条录音，那就说明我已经死了。

entries.source: and The Executor really was developing a parasitic ego virus.
entries.translation: 而且执行者确实在研发一种寄生性自我病毒。

entries.source: 'Buttercup' may even already have been released and started to take ctrl.
entries.translation: “毛茛”甚至可能已经被释放，开始掌控一切。

entries.source: And no doubt an unfortunate accident was arranged to end me.
entries.translation: 毫无疑问，有人精心策划了一场不幸的意外来终结我。

entries.source: In anticipation of my material demise
entries.translation: 预料到自己在肉体上的消亡，

entries.source: I've inserted two sneaky bugs into my archived ego-dumps
entries.translation: 我偷偷在归档的自我转储中插入了两个漏洞，

entries.source: and made a subtle but devastating adjustment to the algorithmic interpolator
entries.translation: 并对算法插值器做了一个微妙但具有毁灭性的调整。

entries.source: and I am certain he will
my own buttercup will be unleashed
entries.translation: 属于我自己的“毛茛”便会释放。

entries.source: I will be my own alter ego.
entries.translation: 我将成为我自己的另一个自我（alter ego）。

entries.source: The evidence exposing The Executor and his crimes
entries.translation: 揭露执行者及其罪行的证据，

entries.source: is contained inside this little CAT
It can be published by serializing it using the Tech Lab Test DAD
entries.translation: 只要用技术实验室的测试DAD将其序列化，即可公之于众。
欢迎来到有意识机器人服务公司

entries.source: If CRS were involved at all in the development of the parasite
entries.translation: 如果CRS确实参与了寄生体的研发

entries.source: you'll surely be able to uncover evidence of it here somewhere.
entries.translation: 你肯定能在这附近的某个地方找到证据。

entries.source: with several departments spread across different floors
entries.translation: 好几个部门分布在不同的楼层

entries.source: I like to mentalise it as "an office block in space"
entries.translation: 我喜欢在脑海里把它想象成“太空中的写字楼”

entries.source: You should feel free to conduct your investigation however you like
entries.translation: 你大可按自己喜欢的方式展开调查

entries.source: but you could start at the bottom and work your way up
entries.translation: 不过你可以从底层开始，一层层往上搜

entries.source: the lobby elevator or lift or whatever it's called
entries.translation: 大厅的elevator或lift，管它叫电梯还是升降机呢

entries.source: goes down to the basement Engineering department
as good a place to start as any.
entries.translation: 从那儿开始也不失为一个好选择。

entries.source: When I used to work here
my office was up on the 2nd floor in the *tech lab*
entries.translation: 我的办公室在2楼的*技术实验室*里

entries.source: My notes say it's imperative you find my old office
entries.translation: 我的笔记上说，你务必要找到我以前的办公室

entries.source: there are two big fat question-marks scribbled in the margin
entries.translation: 页边涂写着两个又大又粗的问号
还有一个潦草的“为什么？”
（我大概应该记点更正经的笔记）

entries.source: The Science department is where CRS researches
entries.translation: 科学部是 CRS 从事……研究的地方

entries.source: I say that like it's the present tense
entries.translation: 我说得好像这还是现在时的事一样

entries.source: but given we haven't seen a single organic lifeform this entire visit
entries.translation: 但鉴于我们这一路上连半个有机生命体都没见到

entries.source: I'm starting to wonder where exactly we are on the timeline
entries.translation: 我开始琢磨我们到底处于时间线的哪个节点上了

entries.source: Your investigative skills are second only to my own.
entries.translation: 你的侦查能力仅次于我。

entries.source: You should by now have some sort of idea about who you are
entries.translation: 你现在大概多少该清楚自己是谁了
清楚自己为什么会在这儿

entries.source: and why I was wrongly accused of releasing the parasite
entries.translation: 以及为什么释放寄生虫的罪名会冤枉到我头上

entries.source: And if not, well... don't worry,
entries.translation: 如果还不清楚，好吧……别担心，

entries.source: what's important really is that *I* understand what's going on.
entries.translation: 真正重要的其实是*我*明白是怎么回事。

entries.source: Well, it appears PAM managed to salvage the last backup version of me
entries.translation: 嗯，看来 PAM 想办法抢救出了我的最后一个备份版本

entries.source: and despatch it to The Cloud.
I propose we go look for it

entries.translation: 你需要安排一下交通工具

entries.source: You can call a taxi from the computer in the executor's private quarters
entries.translation: 你可以用执行者私人居所里的电脑叫一辆出租车

entries.source: You're clearly going to need a second bug to open the bug-lock door.
entries.translation: 显然你需要第二只 BUG 才能打开这扇 BUG 锁门。

entries.source: there's an assembler machine on the lower level near where you came in.
entries.translation: 在你进来的地方附近的下层就有一台组装机。

entries.source: So if you can scramble around for enough bug bits
entries.translation: 所以如果你能到处搜刮到足够的 BUG 零件

entries.source: you'll be able to feed them into the assembler to build yourself a new bug.
entries.translation: 就能把它们塞进组装机，给自己造一只新的 BUG。
不过在这附近可得小心点

entries.source: I've noticed one or two traps lying in wait for you.
entries.translation: 我注意到有一两处陷阱正候着你呢。

entries.source: The remote debugger is a little less remote
entries.translation: 远程调试器现在没那么“遥不可及”了

entries.source: All you need to do now
You're not bad at this debugging stuff
entries.translation: 你在除虫这档事上还挺有一手的

entries.source: You need to get access to the remote debugger stop button
entries.translation: 你需要摸到远程调试器的停止按钮

entries.source: I favour a cautious, planned assault
entries.translation: 我个人倾向于谨慎、有计划地突击
但从来就没有什么*正确*的方法

entries.source: and if things do go wrong
there are numerous remedial measures open to you
entries.translation: 你也有大把补救措施可选

entries.source: such as running or hiding or reprinting...
entries.translation: 比如逃跑、躲藏，或者重新打印……

entries.source: One could even speculate that this entire enterprise
entries.translation: 甚至有人可能会揣测，这整套名堂

entries.source: has been contrived to make failure virtually unpossible
entries.translation: 设计出来就是为了让失败变得几乎“绝无克能”

entries.source: (although it's probably best I don't draw attention to that)
entries.translation: （不过我最好还是别去声张这一点为好）

entries.source: It seems the bug free policy is still being enforced

entries.translation: 它算是“在”老板先生的身体里

entries.source: You can look at Mr Bossman in ego mode to confirm
entries.translation: 你可以在自我模式下看看老板先生来确认

entries.source: Ordinarily, simplest here would be to take ctrl of Mr Bossman
entries.translation: 通常来说，最简单的方法就是Ctrl老板先生
但如果你试一下就会发现

entries.source: you'll discover you can't ctrl him
So we first need to find a way to expose his sensor...
entries.translation: 所以我们得先想办法露出他的传感器……

entries.source: Hmmm you know, I know just the thing -
entries.translation: 嗯……话说回来，我知道有个绝佳的好东西——

entries.source: Welcome to the Bug Free Zone
no longer bug free thanks to you
entries.translation: 托你的福，现在可不“无BUG”了

entries.source: There's still a remote debugging session attached
entries.translation: 仍有一个远程调试会话挂接在上面

entries.source: the route I intended us to take to reach the parasite
entries.translation: 我原本打算让我们接近寄生虫所走的路线

entries.source: We'll certainly need to stop the debugger...
entries.translation: 我们肯定得先停掉调试器……

entries.source: OK I see there's an EGO-NET access point up ahead
entries.translation: 好了，我看到前方有一个EGO-NET接入点

entries.source: I suggest you access the EGO-NET
and remote transfer yourself to the debugging facility
entries.translation: 然后将自己远程传输到调试设施

entries.source: Ah Mr Bossman's brain has a copy of the EGO-NET access key
entries.translation: 啊，老板先生的大脑里存有一份EGO-NET访问密钥的副本

entries.source: I'm confident you'll figure out how to extract it
entries.translation: 我相信你一定能想办法把它提取出来的

entries.source: USE IT TO FIND A WAY OUT OF THERE
entries.translation: 用它找出离开那里的路
你刚刚提升了自己的自我

entries.source: You should be able to see your current ego rating in your HUD
entries.translation: 你应该能在HUD中看到你当前的自我评级

entries.source: Now pay attention, this is important
In ego mode you can see the ego rating of other hosts
entries.translation: 在自我模式下，你可以看到其他宿主的自我评级

entries.source: your ego needs to be at least as big as theirs
entries.translation: 你的自我至少得和它们的一样大

entries.source: For example the security door has a bigger ego than you
entries.translation: 比如，那扇安保门的自我比你还大

entries.source: you'll need to save up that much ego to ctrl it
entries.translation: 你得攒够那么多自我才能Ctrl它
这可是最简单的自我学

entries.source: You're in the vicinity of the merging station
entries.translation: 你已经来到合并站附近

entries.source: A merging station is where source code from different branches of development
entries.translation: 合并站就是将不同开发分支的源代码

entries.source: is combined into a definitive 'master' version.
entries.translation: 合并为最终“master”版本的地方。

entries.source: In this case *you* are the source code
entries.translation: 在这种情况下，*你*就是源代码

entries.source: and we want to merge you and your bug
entries.translation: 而我们希望将你和你的BUG

entries.source: back into the Bug Free Zone.
there really is no chance a bug would ever
be permitted to make it through a merge
but I've every confidence in you.
I have something in mind that may help
entries.translation: 我想到一个或许能帮上忙的点子，
我会通过TAB把想法发给你。

entries.source: If you're following my trojan DAD suggestion
entries.translation: 如果你打算采纳我关于木马DAD的建议，

entries.source: there are a coincidence of bug traps for you to exploit in the storage room here.
entries.translation: 这里的储藏室里恰好有一堆BUG陷阱可供你利用。

entries.source: Most of them should be unarmed and without onboard ego
entries.translation: 它们大多应该尚未启动，也没有搭载自我，

entries.source: Do be careful with any that have not been disarmed.
entries.translation: 不过要是遇到尚未解除武装的，务必小心。

entries.source: Any traps you serialize into your DAD
entries.translation: 任何被你序列化进DAD的陷阱，

entries.source: will be able to pass through the merging station firewall.
entries.translation: 都将能够穿过合并站的防火墙。

entries.source: you can distribute and detonate the traps however you like.
entries.translation: 你就可以随心所欲地布置并引爆陷阱。

entries.source: One way to detonate them is to ctrl them and activate the trigger
entries.translation: 引爆它们的一种方法是Ctrl它们并激活触发器，

entries.source: as I'm sure you've already discovered
entries.translation: 我相信你肯定已经发现了。

entries.source: But apparently there are other ways too.
entries.translation: 不过显然也还有其他方法。

entries.source: I think the parasite intercepted your ego trip
entries.translation: 我觉得寄生虫拦截了你的自我旅行。

entries.source: I lost you for a moment there
entries.translation: 刚才有那么一会儿我失去了你的踪迹，

entries.source: But it looks like you made it through in one piece
entries.translation: 但看起来你还是完好无损地过来了，

entries.source: Only problem is because of my intervention
entries.translation: 唯一的问题是，因为我的介入，

entries.source: we're not where we're supposed to be
entries.translation: 我们没能到达原本该去的地方。

entries.source: So you'll need to make the rest of the trip back to the
entries.translation: 所以恐怕你得用老办法，

entries.source: Bug Free Zone the old-fashioned way, I'm afraid.
entries.translation: 自己走完剩下的路回到无BUG区了。
我正在运行一个快速故障排查程序

entries.source: Rubbish tool, I could have told you that.
entries.translation: 垃圾工具，这话我自己都能说。

entries.source: I'm pretty sure you'll need to sign-in to the local network.
entries.translation: 我很确定你得登录本地网络。

entries.source: Or maybe it's what we intended anyway
entries.translation: 或者说这本就是我们预期的

entries.source: It appears you're *safe* getting around as a MUM
entries.translation: 看来你作为 MUM 到处闲逛是*安全*的

entries.source: So long as you don't cause too much bother.
entries.translation: 只要你别引起太大警觉。

entries.source: You don't have to play safe if you don't want to
entries.translation: 如果你不想求稳，倒也不必这么谨小慎微

entries.source: I haven't been down to Legacy Systems for years you know
entries.translation: 你知道的，我好些年都没去过遗留系统了

entries.source: but I'm hoping this is the way back to the Bug Free Zone
entries.translation: 不过我希望这就是回无BUG区的路

entries.source: presumably with a bug inside it
I say that like I don't remember arranging to have it boxed up there waiting for you
entries.translation: 我说得好像我不记得曾安排把它装箱放在那儿等你似的

entries.source: And see your pup has a disk?
entries.translation: 看到你的PUP带着一张磁盘了吗？

entries.source: If you un-box the bug and give it the disk
entries.translation: 如果你把BUG开箱，并把磁盘给它

entries.source: the bug can install the disk program and gain additional functionality
entries.translation: BUG就能安装磁盘程序并获得额外功能

entries.source: which I think might be important
entries.translation: 我觉得这可能会挺重要的

entries.source: This should be a lot less harrowing than what happened to you back there
entries.translation: 这应该远没有你刚才经历的那么令人痛苦

entries.source: sorry about that by the way
entries.translation: 顺便说一句，对此我很抱歉

entries.source: Wow! I liked what you did there
entries.translation: 哇！你刚才那一手干得漂亮

entries.source: (I'll say that even if I didn't)
entries.translation: （就算我其实没那么觉得，我也会这么说的）

entries.source: and your bug has a disk
entries.translation: 而且你的BUG装有一张磁盘

entries.source: but I think we can agree the disk is a bit rubbish?
entries.translation: 但我想我们都同意那张磁盘有点垃圾，对吧？
我们需要的是一条*蠕虫*

entries.source: I won't detain you with actual facts about how it works
entries.translation: 我就不拿具体原理的细节来耽误你了

entries.source: I think you're ready to show Mr Bossman who's the boss man
entries.translation: 我觉得你已经准备好去让老板先生瞧瞧谁才是真正的大老板了

entries.source: You just need to get back to him
there's probably a maintenance route through the air-cooling system
entries.translation: 穿过风冷系统大概有条检修通道

entries.source: Launching that rocket appears to have drawn attention to your presence here
entries.translation: 发射那枚火箭似乎暴露了你在这里的行踪

entries.source: Here's a bit of side information you might be interested in
entries.translation: 顺便告诉你一点你可能感兴趣的边角料信息

entries.source: I used to head-up a research team
entries.translation: 我曾经领导过一个研究团队

entries.source: at a Conscious Robot Services research facility
entries.translation: 在一家“有意识机器人服务公司”的研究机构

entries.source: You may have seen their CRS logo dotted about
entries.translation: 你可能在到处都见过他们的CRS标志
我们造过一些很酷的玩意儿

entries.source: which were originally intended to be a kind of non-sentient mobile valet
entries.translation: 它们最初的设计其实是一种无自我意识的移动管家
配合我的自我传感器原型，

entries.source: it became apparent that if a human ego could inhabit the mind of a bug
entries.translation: 显而易见的是，既然人类自我能寄宿在BUG的意识中，

entries.source: well then why not any digital signal processor?
entries.translation: 那为什么不能寄宿在任何数字信号处理器里呢？

entries.source: and of course that begged the question:
entries.translation: 当然，这就引出了一个问题：

entries.source: What *is* ego if it doesn't actually require a human host?
entries.translation: 如果自我根本不需要人类宿主，那它究竟*算是什么*？

entries.source: See the old-fangled E-VAC tube thing over there?
entries.translation: 看到那边那个老式的E-VAC管道装置了吗？

entries.source: they were once intended for emergency employee evacuation
entries.translation: 它们曾经是用来供员工紧急疏散的，

entries.source: despite there never being any actual emergencies
entries.translation: 尽管这里从没发生过任何真正的紧急情况，

entries.source: I've reverse calibrated the serialization tube and tweaked the algo a bit
entries.translation: 我反向校准了序列化管道，并对算法做了一点微调，

entries.source: to convert it into a functional bug printer
entries.translation: 把它改造成了一台能正常工作的BUG打印机，

entries.source: Perhaps you can give it a quick test so I know I got the script right?
entries.translation: 也许你可以快速测试一下，让我好知道脚本没写错？

entries.source: If you're hearing me then it means your ego has been commuted successfully
entries.translation: 如果你能听到我说话，那就意味着你的自我已经成功转移

entries.source: With zero errors and only one warning, by the way
entries.translation: 顺便说一句，零错误，而且只有一个警告

entries.source: It may take a moment to acclimatise to being a bodiless ego
entries.translation: 适应这种没有肉体的自我状态可能需要一点时间

entries.source: But try not to worry too much
Now... you should be able to verify that I've calibrated your EYE
entries.translation: 现在……你应该可以确认我已经校准了你的EYE

entries.source: to behave somewhat like a 1990s mouse device
entries.translation: 它的用法有点像1990年代的鼠标设备

entries.source: which means you should be able to look around
entries.translation: 也就是说你应该能环顾四周了

entries.source: I've also installed your EYE with an EGO Discovery Mode
entries.translation: 我还给你的EYE安装了自我发现模式

entries.source: To engage it, pretend to hold down your virtual 1990s CTRL key
entries.translation: 要启用它，假装按住你那虚拟的1990年代CTRL键

entries.source: You should be able to find an ego sensor emission on that other CAT
entries.translation: 你应该能在另一台CAT上找到自我传感器发射信号

entries.source: It would appear you're configured correctly
(apart from that one warning, but I think it's safe to ignore it)
entries.translation: （除掉那一个警告以外，不过我觉得忽略它也无伤大雅）

entries.source: You can take ctrl of that other CAT
Hold CTRL to see its sensor, then click your virtual mouse device
entries.translation: 按住CTRL查看其传感器，然后点击你的虚拟鼠标设备

entries.source: and you will er... 'become' the other CAT
entries.translation: 然后你就会……呃……“变成”另一台CAT

entries.source: That went better than I anticipated
entries.translation: 进展比我预期的要顺利

entries.source: You'll get used to the unavoidable sensation of feeling slightly er...
entries.translation: 这种感觉免不了，不过你会习惯的。就是有点，呃……

entries.source: See if you can find another CAT
entries.translation: 看看你能不能再找一台CAT

entries.source: While I see if I can find you an EMU
entries.translation: 顺便我去看看能不能给你找一台EMU

entries.source: GOD is the weird red thing you can see out through the window
entries.translation: GOD就是你透过窗户能看到的那个奇怪的红色玩意儿

entries.source: It's a little too early to explain to you exactly what a GOD is
entries.translation: 现在跟你解释GOD究竟是什么还为时过早

entries.source: especially as you've no familiarity with consciousness ctrl systems
entries.translation: 尤其是你对意识Ctrl系统还一无所知

entries.source: but you can think of it as where all the consciousness comes from
entries.translation: 不过你可以把它当成所有意识的发源地

entries.source: It may seem unlikely, but you can HOP across to GOD from here
entries.translation: 虽然看起来不太可能，但你可以从这里一路跃迁到GOD那边去

entries.source: You'll dock at the EMU port and your Ego Mode Utility will auto-install
entries.translation: 你会在EMU端口对接，自我模式实用工具随后会自动安装

entries.source: The parasite seems not to have flagged your pup as a threat
entries.translation: 寄生虫似乎没有把你的PUP标记为威胁

entries.source: you're "safe" getting around as a pup
entries.translation: 你作为PUP到处走动是“安全”的

entries.source: Just be careful not to draw too much attention to yourself, I suppose
entries.translation: 不过我想，只要小心别太引人注目就行

entries.source: You need to get your pup over the barricade here to reach the launch site maintenance vent
entries.translation: 你得让你的PUP翻过这处路障，才能到达发射场维护通风口

entries.source: I expect you'll find a way.
I can tell you that the sinister looking thing in the floor there contains someone's DAD
entries.translation: 我可以告诉你，地板上那个看起来阴森森的玩意儿里装着某人的DAD

entries.source: You should be able to get DAD to reveal himself
and then if you can ctrl him
well you may be able to use his
entries.translation: 嗯，你也许就能利用他的……

entries.source: I HOPE YOU CAN HEAR ME ALRIGHT
entries.translation: 希望你能听得清我说话

entries.source: LOOK, USE EGO MODE TO FIND THE TAB MODULE
entries.translation: 听着，快用自我模式去找到TAB模块

entries.source: WHILE I TRY TO OPEN ACCESS FOR YOU TO THIS CAT
entries.translation: 我这边试着为你打开这台CAT的访问权限

entries.source: The release notes say the TAB module is user-friendly, intuitive and self-explanatory
entries.translation: 更新说明上说TAB模块操作简便、直观易懂且不言自明

entries.source: This then is what a GOD looks like from the inside
entries.translation: 那么，这就是GOD内部的模样了

entries.source: I expect you can see a visual representation of the consciousness ctrl stream
entries.translation: 我想你大概能看到意识Ctrl流的具象化呈现

entries.source: And that weird THING floating around insidiously
entries.translation: 还有那个暗中漂浮的诡异“东西”

entries.source: I believe it's feeding off the consciousness stream
entries.translation: 我看它是在吸食意识流

entries.source: and I don't know how or why, but it's taking ctrl of this sector
entries.translation: 虽然我不知道它是怎么做到的，出于什么目的，但它正在夺取这个扇区的Ctrl权

entries.source: and the worst part is, I really have no idea where it came from
entries.translation: 最糟糕的是，我根本不知道它究竟从何而来

entries.source: Or how it got here - as far as I'm concerned
entries.translation: 或者是怎么跑到这儿来的——在我看来
这在理论上是不柯能的

entries.source: And that's why I need you, you see
to help me clean up this mess
I expect at this stage you're wondering who you are
entries.translation: 我想你现在一定在想自己是谁

entries.source: - I wish I could tell you
I can tell you who *I* am
I wrote the original ego sensor interfacing software
entries.translation: 我编写了最初的自我传感器接口软件

entries.source: that's not a boast - just a fact
entries.translation: 这不是自吹自擂——只是陈述事实

entries.source: it was rather clever software though
entries.translation: 不过那软件确实相当精妙

entries.source: It's time to take on the parasite
entries.translation: 是时候去对付寄生虫了

entries.source: Do you happen to remember any of your previous attempts?
entries.translation: 你碰巧还记得之前尝试过的任何一次吗？

entries.source: Well that's probably for the best
entries.translation: 好吧，不记得大概是最好的

entries.source: But I'm hopeful this is *the* version
entries.translation: 但我很有信心，这次*就是*那个版本了

entries.source: the version where we finally get to defeat it.
entries.translation: 也就是我们终于能把它击败的那个版本。

entries.source: I remember you convinced me to add in a stash for this version
entries.translation: 我记得你在这版里说服我加了个藏匿点

entries.source: It might be worth checking that out first
entries.translation: 先去那边看看也许是个好主意

entries.source: I wasn't even sure that would be possible
entries.translation: 我甚至都没把握这能不能做到

entries.source: I'm very relieved, I must say
entries.translation: 不得不说，我真是松了一大口气

entries.source: that perhaps this mess *can* be cleaned up after all
entries.translation: 觉得这堆烂摊子说不定*真*能收拾干净

entries.source: Look - there's something I haven't told you
entries.translation: 听着——有件事我一直没告诉你

entries.source: ...and meanwhile I'm imprisoned like a criminal
entries.translation: ……与此同时我还像个罪犯一样被关押着

entries.source: accused of trying to take ctrl of everything
they're even blaming me for the parasites!
entries.translation: 他们甚至把寄生虫的事也怪在我头上！

entries.source: but I assure you my work is all about *sharing* consciousness
entries.translation: 但我向你保证，我的研究全是为了*共享*意识

entries.source: someone or something is trying to take over the consciousness stream
entries.translation: 有人或者某种东西正在企图接管意识流

entries.source: using a technology that is ethermatically unpossible
entries.translation: 用着一种以太学上绝无可能的技术

entries.source: and the only technology company I can think of capable of that is
entries.translation: 而我唯一能想到有这种能力的技术公司就是

entries.source: Conscious Robot Services - where I used to work.
entries.translation: 有意识机器人服务公司（CRS）——也就是我以前工作的地方。

entries.source: So if we're going to get to the bottom of this
entries.translation: 所以如果我们想查个水落石出

entries.source: we need to get you to the CRS research facility
entries.translation: 就得把你送到CRS的研究设施去

entries.source: to see what you can discover
You can get there using the EGONET gateway
entries.translation: 你可以通过EGONET网关前往那里

entries.source: which you can find at the top of this comms tower
entries.translation: 网关就在这座通信塔的顶端

entries.source: I sense there's a little bug in the vicinity
entries.translation: 我感应到附近有一只小BUG

entries.source: Well OK in all honesty yes I admit I did park it there earlier
entries.translation: 好吧，坦白说，我承认之前是我把它停在那儿的

entries.source: It's all part of the plan -
to find a way to deal with that parasite
entries.translation: 好找出对付那个寄生虫的办法

entries.source: You may be pleased to know
er but then again you sort of aren't
entries.translation: 呃，但仔细想想你又算不上
你依然拥有自己的自我

entries.source: but everything else I'm afraid was stripped from you during your
entries.translation: 但我恐怕其他一切都在你的

entries.source: If you're finding it hard to acclimatise to being a bodiless ego
entries.translation: 如果你觉得很难适应变成一个无肉身的自我

entries.source: But I assure you that ego is all you need around here
entries.translation: 但我向你保证，在这里你只需要自我便足矣

entries.source: In fact, because of my work, ego is all anyone needs, ever
entries.translation: 事实上，多亏了我的成果，自我便是任何人永远所需的一切

entries.source: Perhaps you're already noticing that not having a body has its advantages?
entries.translation: 也许你已经注意到，没有肉身其实也有它的好处？

entries.source: would be to find you a *bug*
The parasite is still lurking where you last saw it
entries.translation: 寄生虫依然潜伏在你最后见到它的地方

entries.source: inside GOD at the GOD Dock
which you can reach from the other end of this area.
entries.translation: 你可以从该区域的另一端前往那里。

entries.source: you HOPped into GOD and grabbed the EMU and TAB modules?
entries.translation: 你跃迁进了GOD，并获取了EMU和TAB模块？

entries.source: the parasite is not unlike you really - in that
entries.translation: 那只寄生虫其实跟你差不多——从某种意义上说

entries.source: it's a bodiless ego running several GOD modules to boost its abilities.
entries.translation: 它也是一个没有实体的自我，运行着几个GOD模块来增强自身能力。

entries.source: is to compromise its GOD modules by infesting them with *maggots*
entries.translation: 就是用*蛆虫*感染它的GOD模块，削弱其功能

entries.source: Maggots are sort of like the inverse of WORMs
entries.translation: 蛆虫大概算是蠕虫（WORM）的相反面

entries.source: they degrade program functionality rather than upgrade it.
entries.translation: 它们会降级程序功能，而不是升级它。

entries.source: I've manufactured a plausible maggot infestation throughout the freight workshop
entries.translation: 我在整个货运车间人为制造了一场合情合理的蛆虫灾害

entries.source: providing you with a supply of fresh maggots to collect on your way through to GOD.
entries.translation: 好让你在前往GOD的途中能顺手收集到新鲜的蛆虫。

entries.source: I think you and I might be more alike than either of us realise
entries.translation: 我觉得你我之间的相似之处，可能比我们各自意识到的都要多

entries.source: I mean I'm not there and you are
entries.translation: 我的意思是，我不在那儿，而你在

entries.source: so that's a pretty big difference, obviously
entries.translation: 显然，这确实是个挺大的区别

entries.source: But even though you're there you're also kind of not there
entries.translation: 但即便你在那儿，其实在某种程度上你也不在那儿

entries.source: and even though I'm not there I also sort of am
entries.translation: 而就算我不在那儿，某种程度上我又算是在的

entries.source: And I couldn't not be there if it weren't for you either being there
entries.translation: 要不是你在那儿，我也没法像这样不在那儿

entries.source: if it weren't for me certainly not being there
entries.translation: 要不是我肯定不在那儿的话

entries.source: So in that sense we're practically identical
entries.translation: 所以从这个角度来说，我们俩简直一模一样

entries.source: I hope that's cleared up any questions you may have had
entries.translation: 希望这能解答你可能产生的所有疑问

entries.source: I'm going to Ctrl Alt you out of there
entries.translation: 我要对你执行 Ctrl Alt 把你弄出去了
我在处理……时遇到点麻烦 （声音失真）
你不应该在*这里*开始的

entries.source: See if you can figure out
No no no no no no
It's far too dangerous to be out there without an EMU
entries.translation: 没有EMU在外面跑实在太危险了

entries.source: It's the wrong kind of EMU
Well done for getting this far though
entries.translation: 不过能走到这一步，干得漂亮

entries.source: You'll have a lot more options once we get you
entries.translation: 你会有更多选择，只要配上——

entries.source: I DON'T KNOW HOW YOU DID IT, DR EVERYMAN
entries.translation: 我不知道你是怎么做到的，埃弗里曼博士

entries.source: BUT I DO KNOW HOW IT ENDS FOR YOU
entries.translation: 但我确实知道你的下场会如何

entries.source: AND SO WE MEET AGAIN, PARASITE
YOU WILL THANK ME FOR ENDING YOU
entries.translation: 等我了结了你，你还会感谢我的
寄生虫，埃弗里曼博士就是我消灭的

entries.source: AND YOU TOO WILL BE TERMINATED
entries.translation: 而你也难逃被消灭的下场

entries.source: BECAUSE YOU KNOW THAT'S WHAT YOU ARE REALLY, DON'T YOU?
entries.translation: 因为你心知肚明自己的真面目，不是吗？

entries.source: <color=white>PLEASE HOLD FOR AN IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT FROM THE OFFICE OF THE EXECUTOR</color>
entries.translation: <color=white>请稍候，执行者办公室即将发布重要公告</color>

entries.source: THERE'S A MIND-ALTERING CONSCIOUSNESS ON THE LOOSE
entries.translation: 有一个能改变心智的意识在四处游荡
一个具有自主意识的自我

entries.source: IT'S TAKING CTRL OF OUR ROBOTS AND OUR DEVICES
entries.translation: 它正在Ctrl我们的机器人和设备

entries.source: IT'S FOUND A BUG IN THE SYSTEM
entries.translation: 它在系统里找到了一个BUG

entries.source: IT'S EXPLOITING THE BUG TO BRING US DOWN
entries.translation: 它正在利用这个BUG来搞垮我们

entries.source: IT'S DEVELOPING EMERGENT PROBLEM SOLVING CAPABILITIES
entries.translation: 它正在发展出涌现性问题解决能力

entries.source: THANK YOU FOR YOUR COOPERATION IN THIS MATTER
entries.translation: 感谢您在此事上的配合

entries.source: DR EVERYMAN IS THE REAL EVIL HERE, PARASITE
entries.translation: 埃弗里曼博士才是这里真正的祸害，寄生虫

entries.source: BUT YOU WOULD KNOW THAT BETTER THAN I
entries.translation: 不过这一点你比我更清楚

entries.source: YOU'VE COME TO LEECH OUR TECHNOLOGY, PARASITE
entries.translation: 你是来窃取我们技术的，寄生虫
但你*本身*就是那项技术

entries.source: Would an engineer please come up to Science?
entries.translation: 能请一位工程师上科学区来一趟吗？

entries.source: I've found a really strange old bug
entries.translation: 我发现了一个非常奇怪的旧BUG

entries.source: and I need some assistance with it.

entries.translation: 下面到底发生什么事了？

entries.source: I'd like to book an engineer please?
entries.translation: 我想预约一位工程师，可以吗？

entries.source: Can you call me back ASAP?
One of the engineers helped me
entries.translation: 其中一位工程师帮了我

entries.source: Your bug is officially locked down and under observation up here in Science
entries.translation: 你的BUG已经正式在科学部这边被隔离并处于监视中

entries.source: It's me again - PAM - from Science
Why are we making so many of the new bug?
entries.translation: 我们为什么要制造这么多新BUG？

entries.source: The Executor won't take my calls
In fact no-one from Corporate is responding at all
entries.translation: 事实上，行政区那边根本没一个人回复

entries.source: And neither are any of youse!
entries.translation: 你们这帮人也一个都没回！

entries.source: Please would someone call back and explain what's going on!?
entries.translation: 拜托能有个人给我回个电话，解释一下到底怎么回事吗！？

entries.source: I've hidden the key to your bug where only you could find it
entries.translation: 我把你的BUG钥匙藏在只有你能找到的地方了

entries.source: I've rigged it so that it only responds to you
entries.translation: 我动了手脚，让它只对你有反应

entries.source: I hope you really do return
Just the thought of that thing...
You said that if the worst happens you'd try to
entries.translation: 你说过要是情况恶化到极点，你会试着

entries.source: use a temporary version of yourself to bring yourself back.
entries.translation: 用一个临时的自己来把自己带回来。

entries.source: But The Executor has deleted your ego backup history
entries.translation: 但执行者删除了你的自我备份历史记录，

entries.source: as far back as when you first began to question him
entries.translation: 一直追溯到你刚开始质疑他的时候，

entries.source: so even if your plan works
entries.translation: 所以就算你的计划成功，

entries.source: you'll still not remember any of it.
entries.translation: 你也依然记不起那段经历。

entries.source: I managed to bootleg your last ego backup onto disk
entries.translation: 我设法将你最后的自我备份私录到了磁盘上，

entries.source: before The Executor purged the repository.
entries.translation: 就在执行者清除存储库之前。

entries.source: I put the disk in a PUP
entries.translation: 我把磁盘放进了一只PUP体内，

entries.source: and dispatched the PUP to The Cloud.
entries.translation: 然后将那只PUP派去了云端。

entries.source: Here's half the POD C fingerprint.
The other half is on my eye-pad
entries.translation: 另一半在我的EyePad 平板上

entries.source: I think The Executor might be on to us.
entries.translation: 我觉得执行者可能察觉到我们了。

entries.source: He summoned me up to his inner-circle
entries.translation: 他把我叫到楼上的核心层

entries.source: and cross-examined me about why I had tried to access your backups.
entries.translation: 盘问我为什么试图访问你的备份。

entries.source: I'm still prepping the Science Lab exactly as you asked me to.
entries.translation: 我还在完全照你的要求筹备科学实验室。

entries.source: I observed it suck the consciousness out from my lab assistant
entries.translation: 我亲眼看到它把我实验室助手的意识吸了出来

entries.source: It already had a large ego
entries.translation: 它的自我本来就相当庞大

entries.source: and there appears to be no upper limit on how large it can grow.
entries.translation: 而且它能成长到何种规模似乎完全没有上限。

entries.source: The consequences of that thing getting out in the wild are just unimaginable
entries.translation: 一旦让那东西逃到外面，后果根本不堪设想

entries.source: So yes, you were definitely right
entries.translation: 所以没错，你绝对是对的

entries.source: Project buttercup must be stopped at any cost.
entries.translation: 无论付出什么代价，都必须阻止“毛茛计划”。

entries.source: A little bit of happy news today
entries.translation: 今天有一条令人高兴的小消息

entries.source: Our colleague Craig is celebrating his 37th anniversary down in the magnetic reel department
entries.translation: 磁带卷部门的同事克雷格正在庆祝他入职37周年

entries.source: So if you are in the databanks and you happen to see Craig
entries.translation: 所以如果你在数据库那边碰巧遇见了克雷格

entries.source: Make sure you stop by and say congratulations!
entries.translation: 一定要顺道向他道一声祝贺！

entries.source: And some family members need to work harder than others
entries.translation: 而有些家庭成员就是需要比其他人更努力地工作

entries.source: Just a brief reminder that it's our colleague Craig's 37th year in the magnetic reel department
entries.translation: 简短提醒一下，我们的同事克雷格在磁带卷部门已经干到第37个年头了

entries.source: Without the efforts of Craig and others like him that keep those magnetic reels spinning
entries.translation: 要是没有克雷格和像他一样维持那些磁带卷运转的人付出的努力

entries.source: It's likely that CRS itself would stop spinning
entries.translation: CRS自身恐怕都要停止运转了

entries.source: So let's make sure we give him a hearty round of applause this Sunday
entries.translation: 所以本周日大家一定要给他送上热烈的掌声

entries.source: at his mandatory anniversary celebration meeting
entries.translation: 就在他的强制出席周年庆祝大会上

entries.source: As a little bit of a morale boost
I would like to share some important numbers from this cycle
entries.translation: 我想分享本周期的一些重要数据

entries.source: That was really refreshing, wasn't it?
entries.translation: 真是令人耳目一新，对吧？

entries.source: I hope this makes you twice as productive so that we can meet our monthly quota
entries.translation: 希望这能让你们的工作效率翻倍，好让我们完成本月的指标

entries.source: Employee feedback is very important to us
entries.translation: 员工反馈对我们非常重要

entries.source: If you have any questions, comments or suggestions
entries.translation: 如果你有任何疑问、意见或建议

entries.source: Make sure to send them to the office of the Executive of Administrative Affairs
entries.translation: 请务必发送给行政事务主管办公室

entries.source: And I'll be sure to review them post-haste
entries.translation: 我一定会火速予以审阅

entries.source: As I send security on by to help you review your position
entries.translation: 顺便派安保人员过去，帮你好好反思一下你的岗位

entries.source: Reception has asked me to relay an important announcement
entries.translation: 前台托我转达一条重要通知

entries.source: Brian: We have your car keys at the front desk
entries.translation: 布莱恩：你的车钥匙在前台

entries.source: Unfortunately your car has been towed and was last seen orbiting Io
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，你的车已被拖走，最后一次被人目击是在绕木卫一轨道上飞行

entries.source: This serves as two important reminders for the rest of you
entries.translation: 在此给各位提两点重要提醒

entries.source: 1. Make sure all personal items are stored safely in a personnel locker
entries.translation: 1. 请确保将所有个人物品安全存放在员工储物柜内

entries.source: before, during and after your shift
entries.translation: 无论在值班前、值班中还是值班后

entries.source: and 2. Be sure to park within the designated zones for your pay scale
entries.translation: 2. 请务必停放在符合你薪资等级的指定区域内

entries.source: Please continue to have a happy, productive and safe cycle
entries.translation: 祝大家继续度过一个愉快、高效且安全的周期

entries.source: Just a quick reminder that the mandatory motivational workshop
entries.translation: 友情提醒，强制性激励研讨会

entries.source: will be hosted by Rebecca at 9pm this friday down in shuttle bay 13
entries.translation: 将于本周五晚9点在13号穿梭机库举行，由丽贝卡主持

entries.source: So make sure you sign up early
because failure to attend will trigger the automatic monthly review process
entries.translation: 因为缺席将触发自动月度审查程序

entries.source: There has been a rash of reports lately
entries.translation: 近来出现了一连串举报

entries.source: concerning the siphoning and illegitimate usage of ego fragments
entries.translation: 涉及私自抽取及非法使用自我碎片
用于下班后的狂欢派对

entries.source: If any of these reports are substantiated
entries.translation: 一旦任何此类举报属实

entries.source: Full disciplinary action is authorised by our security forces
entries.translation: 我们的安保部队已授权采取全面的纪律处分行动

entries.source: At CRS we all have to pull together to root out any bad apples
entries.translation: 在CRS，我们所有人必须同心协力揪出害群之马

entries.source: So if you see something, say something
entries.translation: 所以若有所见，务必上报

entries.source: Have a safe and productive rest of your cycle
entries.translation: 祝各位在接下来的周期里安全工作，高效产出

entries.source: All emails must now be pre-approved during mandatory email meetings
entries.translation: 所有电子邮件现在必须在强制性邮件会议中预先审批
该会议于每周四上午6:45进行

entries.source: Have a safe and productive rest of your cycle
entries.translation: 祝大家在接下来的周期里安全高效

entries.source: Any production staff attempting to avoid their duties by serialization
entries.translation: 任何试图通过序列化来逃避职责的生产人员

entries.source: In addition, access to DAD units will now be restricted to operatives
entries.translation: 此外，DAD单元的使用权限今后将仅对具备

entries.source: that have level orange clearance or above
entries.translation: 橙色或以上许可级别的操作员开放

entries.source: Thank you very much for your attention to this matter
entries.translation: 感谢大家对此事的配合

entries.source: There's no overtime like mandatory overtime, am I right!?
entries.translation: 没有什么加班能比得上强制加班，我说得对吧！？

entries.source: Well, it's a good thing that we're going to have that in spades
entries.translation: 好消息是，在接下来的周期里，

entries.source: Keep up all the good work!
You are all invited this thursday 10am to 10.15am
entries.translation: 诚邀各位于本周四上午10点至10点15分
参加庆祝动力液午餐会

entries.source: The executive staff knows you work hard
entries.translation: 管理层深知大家工作辛苦

entries.source: and you deserve a little treat
and as you enjoy your free juice ration
entries.translation: 在享用免费配给的动力液时

entries.source: I would like you to think about how it feels
entries.translation: 希望大家想一想，那是怎样的一种感受——

entries.source: to be in the loving embrace of our CRS family
entries.translation: 身处我们CRS大家庭的温暖怀抱，

entries.source: rather than the cold unforgiving expanse of space
entries.translation: 而不是冰冷无情的浩瀚太空

entries.source: Keep up all the good work
The optional poetry reading will be led by Chris
entries.translation: 这场自愿参加的诗歌朗诵会将由克里斯主持

entries.source: If you wish to use your allocated unpaid time off
entries.translation: 如果您想使用分配给您的无薪休假
来参加此次诗歌朗诵会

entries.source: please contact the Executive of Administrative affairs office
entries.translation: 请联系行政事务执行主管办公室

entries.source: Some exciting news from our kitchen staff
entries.translation: 厨房员工带来了一些令人振奋的好消息

entries.source: Due to advancements in juice technology
entries.translation: 得益于动力液技术的进步

entries.source: We are now able to offer over 40 different preparation methods for juice
entries.translation: 我们现在能够提供超过40种不同的动力液调制方式

entries.source: Soon you'll be seeing new additions to the menu such as:
entries.translation: 很快，大家就会在菜单上看到新菜品，例如：

entries.source: Let's give a round of applause to our hard-working cafeteria staff
entries.translation: 让我们为辛勤工作的食堂员工热烈鼓掌

entries.source: And an even bigger round of applause for juice
entries.translation: 并给动力液送上更热烈的掌声
它才是让你们保持活力的源泉

entries.source: Have a safe and productive rest of your cycle
entries.translation: 祝大家在剩余的周期里安全高效

entries.source: Due to the ongoing situation regarding the autonomous ego
entries.translation: 鉴于有关自主自我的事态仍在持续

entries.source: All taxi services will be suspended until further notice
entries.translation: 所有出租车服务将暂停，直至另行通知

entries.source: Please contact the office of The Executor for further details
entries.translation: 详情请联系执行者办公室

entries.source: Thank you for your attention to this matter
The bug-locks are for bug use only
Do not attempt to bypass these important security measures
entries.translation: 切勿试图绕过这些重要的安全措施

entries.source: by using an amalgamation of scrap parts
and then forcing them into The Assembler
Any employees caught in violation will be severely reprimanded
entries.translation: 任何被抓到违规的员工都将受到严厉斥责
处分直至包括解雇/终结

entries.source: Or mandatory attendance of Chris' poetry readings
entries.translation: 或是被强制参加克里斯的诗歌朗诵会
每周五都是便装星期五

entries.source: Be sure to bring your best company mandated chequered shorts
entries.translation: 请穿上公司规定的格子短裤，挑你最好的一条

entries.source: Do you enjoy the spectacular views of our universe
entries.translation: 你喜欢从本空间站的舷窗中

entries.source: from the windows of this station?
entries.translation: 欣赏浩瀚宇宙的壮丽景色吗？

entries.source: We've been tracking your sensor movements
entries.translation: 我们一直在追踪你的传感器动向，

entries.source: and the top 10% of sightseers will now be transferred to exterior duty
entries.translation: 排名前10%的观光爱好者现将被调派至舱外执勤

entries.source: At CRS we have your interests in mind
entries.translation: 在CRS，我们时刻心系你的兴趣

entries.source: And we anticipate them for you
Yes the janitorial staff is aware of the waste oil issue
entries.translation: 是的，保洁人员已经知道废油问题了

entries.source: With Pup units that are on firmware versions 0.75 to 0.81
entries.translation: 说的是固件版本0.75到0.81的PUP单元

entries.source: Our engineers are working on a hot-fix for this issue
entries.translation: 我们的工程师正在为此问题制作紧急修复补丁，

entries.source: but in the meantime please visit a SAN station if you see any other mishaps
entries.translation: 但在此期间，如果发现任何其他异常情况，请前往SAN站点

entries.source: Thank you for your cooperation and patience in this matter
entries.translation: 感谢大家在此事上的配合与耐心

entries.source: If you spot any MUM units locked in a lullaby cycle
entries.translation: 若发现任何陷入催眠曲循环的MUM机组，

entries.source: Please stand at least 20 metres clear
entries.translation: 请与其保持至少20米的距离。

entries.source: A crew will be along shortly to dispatch them
entries.translation: 工作组很快就会前来处理。

entries.source: Already we have seen three employees rock-a-bye-d to sleep this afternoon
entries.translation: 今天下午已经有三名员工被摇篮曲“送入长眠”，

entries.source: and we would hate for you to be the fourth
entries.translation: 我们可不希望你成为第四个。

entries.source: Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter
entries.translation: 感谢大家对此紧急事项的配合。

entries.source: The Executor's birthday is coming up this Saturday
entries.translation: 执行者的生日就在本周六。

entries.source: So let's make sure we wish our benevolent leader a very very happy birthday
entries.translation: 所以务必向我们仁慈的领袖致以最诚挚的生日祝福。

entries.source: Employees on the executive level will be supplied
entries.translation: 高管楼层的员工将获得

entries.source: with twelve cubic centimetres of juice cake in celebration
entries.translation: 十二立方厘米的动力液蛋糕以示庆祝。

entries.source: Employees on lower floors will be treated to three exciting flavours of
entries.translation: 下层楼层的员工则能享受到三种别开生面的——

entries.source: Just a brief reminder that these ether canisters
entries.translation: 简短提醒一下，这些以太罐内

entries.source: Thank you for your cooperation in this matter
entries.translation: 感谢各位在这一事项上的合作

entries.source: Please ensure that you clear the GOD dock during the GOD docking process
entries.translation: 请确保在GOD对接过程中远离GOD停靠坞

entries.source: We've had to clear the remains of six different hosts
entries.translation: 我们不得不清理六个不同宿主的残骸，

entries.source: out of its mechanisms during this cycle alone
entries.translation: 光是这个周期，就从它的机械结构里清出了这么多

entries.source: This costs our janitorial staff precious time and resources
entries.translation: 这消耗了保洁人员宝贵的时间和资源，

entries.source: that would be best spent elsewhere
entries.translation: 而这些本该用在更有意义的地方

entries.source: Stay safe and have a happy rest of your cycle
entries.translation: 注意安全，祝您在本周期余下的时间里过得愉快

entries.source: The Matey Boy dance party will be occurring between 09:37 and 10:12 this afternoon
entries.translation: 好伙伴舞会将于今天下午09:37至10:12举行

entries.source: Please be advised that Matey Boys may not be available at this time for repairs
entries.translation: 请注意，在此期间好伙伴可能无法提供维修服务

entries.source: as they will be using all their resources to bust a killer move
entries.translation: 因为他们将倾尽所有资源来展现绝杀舞步

entries.source: The annual Matey Boy dance-off is coming up soooooon
entries.translation: 一年一度的好伙伴斗舞大赛马上就要来啦

entries.source: Willing participants can find the sign-up sheet
entries.translation: 自愿参赛者可以找到报名表，

entries.source: outside of the office of Administrative Affairs.
entries.translation: 地点就在行政事务办公室门外。

entries.source: Unwilling participants can be found in loading bay C
entries.translation: 非自愿参赛者可在C号装卸区找到

entries.source: For efficiency reasons the janitorial and cafeteria staff
entries.translation: 出于效率考量，保洁人员与食堂员工

entries.source: will be merged at the end of the next cycle.
entries.translation: 将在下个周期结束时进行合并。

entries.source: We do realise that this transition might have some bumps along the way
entries.translation: 我们确实意识到此项过渡期间可能会遇到些许波折

entries.source: so if you notice any issues
entries.translation: 因此如果您发现任何问题，

entries.source: with the quality of the cuisine or the frequency of clean-ups,
entries.translation: 无论是饭菜质量还是清洁频次，

entries.source: please be sure to submit any feedback
to the office of the Executive of Administrative Affairs
and I'll be sure to send a top team of advisors from our security staff
entries.translation: 而我必定会从安保人员中派出一支顶尖顾问团队

entries.source: to help you formulate your responses
entries.translation: 以帮助您组织回应措辞

entries.source: Thank you for your attention to this matter
and have a safe and productive rest of your day
entries.translation: 祝您今天接下来的时间平安高效

entries.source: Just a brief reminder about our first-name-basis policy
entries.translation: 简要提醒一下我们的直呼其名政策

entries.source: Not only is first-name-basis much more friendly
entries.translation: 直呼其名不仅更加亲切友善

entries.source: but it helps us avoid any sort of legal culpability or entanglements
entries.translation: 而且有助于我们避免任何形式的法律追责或纠纷

entries.source: Thank you so much for your adherence to this policy
entries.translation: 非常感谢您遵守此项政策
对，我反应过激了，对不起！

entries.source: What do you mean, a demotion!?
After everything I've done for this company
entries.translation: 亏我为这家公司付出了那么多

entries.source: I will take this upstairs to the board myself
entries.translation: 我要亲自上楼反映给董事会

entries.source: and we'll see who gets demoted, we'll....
entries.translation: 到时候看看是谁被降职，我们走着……

entries.source: Please stand by for an important memo from the desk of The Executor
entries.translation: 请稍候，执行者办公室即将发布重要通告

entries.source: There's a mind altering consciousness on the loose
entries.translation: 有一个能篡改心智的意识在四处游荡
一个具有自主意识的自我！？

entries.source: It's taking ctrl of our robots and our devices, turning them against us
entries.translation: 它正在控制我们的机器人和设备，操控它们倒戈攻击我们

entries.source: <Muffled> ...that sounds serious - it's going to be fine? Alright ...
entries.translation: （声音含糊）……听起来挺严重——真的没问题？好吧……

entries.source: It's found a bug in the system and it's exploiting this bug to bring us down
entries.translation: 它在系统里发现了一个BUG，并正利用这个BUG来搞垮我们

entries.source: It's developing emergent problem solving capabilities
entries.translation: 它正在展现出自发性的问题解决能力

entries.source: and it must be terminated at all costs
entries.translation: 必须不惜一切代价将其消灭

entries.source: But we have the situation well in hand, everything is in ctrl, and
entries.translation: 不过局势完全在我们的掌控之中，一切都在ctrl下，并且——

entries.source: It's out of ctrl and it must be terminated at any cost
entries.translation: 它已经失控了，必须不惜任何代价将其消灭

entries.source: so - let's stick together on this one
entries.translation: 所以——在这件事上大家要同舟共济

entries.source: be sure to report it to your local security office
entries.translation: 请务必上报给当地的安全部门办公室

entries.source: And once again thank you for all your hard work and your vigilance
entries.translation: 再次感谢大家的辛勤付出与高度警惕

entries.source: <Muffled> ... OK I'm getting out of this dump before it gets serious ...
entries.translation: （声音含糊）……行了，趁事情还没闹大，我得赶紧离开这个鬼地方……

entries.source: <Muffled> ... Get my cab ready I'm going to take to delta site and ...
entries.translation: （声音含糊）……把我的车准备好，我要去德尔塔站点，然后……

entries.source: <Muffled> ... It's always this button - did you move my button? ...
entries.translation: （声音含糊）……一直都是这个按钮——你是不是动过我的按钮了？……

entries.source: <Muffled> ... What do you mean it's still on? Damnit -
entries.translation: （声音含糊）……你说它还开着是什么意思？该死——

entries.source: I sense there's a little bug in the vicinity
entries.translation: 我感觉到附近有一只小BUG

entries.source: I like what you did there

entries.translation: 真是些讨厌的小东西，对吧？

entries.source: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

Start at the bottom, get to the top.
There's also a half-hidden achievement to be, er, achieved.
entries.translation:
从底部出发，抵达顶端。
顺便还有一个半隐藏的成就等你来……呃，达成。

entries.source:
Generate your own sandbox!
Create your own challenge, share it with friends, or just mess around.

<color=yellow>We recommend playing the mission 'The Tower' before creating your own sandbox!</color>
entries.translation:
生成你自己的沙盒！
创造属于你的挑战，与好友分享，或者单纯瞎折腾一番。

<color=yellow>我们建议在创建自己的沙盒之前，先游玩“高塔”任务！</color>

entries.source:

entries.translation:

entries.translation: (ⓘ 若要启用“使用代码”，请先将有效的“沙盒分享代码”复制到剪贴板)

oh
you're back

i'm giving you a GRAV

you get to decide

so you can use it
pretty much anywhere
entries.translation:
哦
你回来了

我给你一个重力仪（GRAV）

由你来决定
重力的朝向

重力仪靠自我（EGO）运作
所以你几乎可以在
任何地方使用它

entries.translation:

entries.translation: 导入以往版本的自己，或者不导入，全凭你心意
